CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_credit_exposure(p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_exclude_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit numeric(14,2); v_open numeric(14,2); v_overdue numeric(14,2);
  v_committed numeric(14,2); v_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_new numeric(14,2) := ROUND(COALESCE(p_new_order_amount,0),2);
  v_proj numeric(14,2); v_disp numeric(14,2); v_pct numeric;
  v_tolerance int; v_block boolean; v_action text; v_reason text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(credit_limit,0), COALESCE(overdue_tolerance_days,0),
         COALESCE(block_if_overdue,false), COALESCE(credit_limit_action,'block')
    INTO v_limit, v_tolerance, v_block, v_action
  FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;
  v_limit := COALESCE(v_limit,0); v_tolerance := COALESCE(v_tolerance,0);
  v_block := COALESCE(v_block,false); v_action := COALESCE(v_action,'block');

  -- (a) recebiveis em aberto do parceiro
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_open
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE');

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_overdue
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    AND ari.due_date < (current_date - v_tolerance);

  -- (b) pedidos com compromisso financeiro real e SEM recebivel gerado
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_committed
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega',
                      'confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  -- (c) H4-001: pedidos vivos ainda nao aprovados ja consomem limite.
  --     Sem isso, N pedidos em analise passavam individualmente no teste
  --     de credito e estouravam o limite ao serem aprovados.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_pending
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('pendente','solicitado','em_analise_comercial',
                      'aguardando_aprovacao_credito','aguardando_ajuste_comercial',
                      'aguardando_itens')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  v_proj := ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending + v_new, 2);
  v_disp := GREATEST(v_limit - v_proj, 0);
  v_pct  := CASE WHEN v_limit > 0 THEN ROUND((v_proj / v_limit) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END;

  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN v_block AND v_overdue > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_BLOCK'
    WHEN v_limit <= 0 THEN 'NO_LIMIT_DEFINED'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit AND v_action = 'approval_required' THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_APPROVAL'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BLOCK'
    ELSE 'OK' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'partner_id', p_partner_id,
    'credit_limit', v_limit,
    'saldo_em_aberto', v_open,
    'saldo_vencido', v_overdue,
    'comprometido_nao_faturado', v_committed,
    'comprometido_pendente', v_pending,
    'novo_pedido', v_new,
    'exposicao_atual', ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending, 2),
    'exposicao_projetada', v_proj,
    'credito_disponivel', v_disp,
    'percentual_utilizado', v_pct,
    'overdue_tolerance_days', v_tolerance,
    'block_if_overdue', v_block,
    'credit_limit_action', v_action,
    'tem_vencidos', v_overdue > 0,
    'reason_code', v_reason
  );
END $function$
functions.name: fn_b2b_credit_exposure

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_cart_hash(p_partner_id uuid, p_plan_id uuid, p_cart jsonb, p_final numeric)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(
    'v2|' || COALESCE(p_partner_id::text,'-') || '|' || COALESCE(p_plan_id::text,'-') || '|' ||
    to_char(ROUND(COALESCE(p_final,0),2),'FM9999999999990.00') || '|' ||
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(
        COALESCE(l->>'item_tipo','')      || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'item_id','')        || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'unidade_medida','') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'quantidade')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'pricing_mode','')   || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'price_source','')   || '~' ||
        COALESCE(l->>'rule_id','')        || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'final_unit_price')::numeric,0),4),'FM9999999999990.0000') || '~' ||
        to_char(ROUND(COALESCE((l->>'line_final_amount')::numeric,0),2),'FM9999999999990.00'),
        ';' ORDER BY COALESCE(l->>'item_tipo',''),
                     COALESCE(l->>'item_id',''),
                     COALESCE(l->>'unidade_medida',''),
                     COALESCE((l->>'volume_ml')::numeric,0),
                     COALESCE((l->>'quantidade')::numeric,0),
                     COALESCE(l->>'rule_id',''))
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_cart->'lines','[]'::jsonb)) l
    ),'') || '|' ||
    COALESCE((p_cart->>'quote_required'),'false')
  ,'UTF8')),'hex')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cockpit_stage(p_status_oficial text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE lower(coalesce(p_status_oficial, ''))
    WHEN 'cancelada'        THEN 'cancelada'
    WHEN 'cancelado'        THEN 'cancelada'
    WHEN 'finalizada'       THEN 'finalizada'
    WHEN 'finalizado'       THEN 'finalizada'
    WHEN 'entregue'         THEN 'entregue'
    WHEN 'aplicado'         THEN 'entregue'
    WHEN 'em_entrega'       THEN 'em_entrega'
    WHEN 'estoque_reservado' THEN 'estoque_reservado'
    WHEN 'estoque_gerado'   THEN 'estoque_disponivel'
    WHEN 'pronto_entrega'   THEN 'estoque_disponivel'
    WHEN 'envase'           THEN 'em_envase'
    WHEN 'em_envase'        THEN 'em_envase'
    WHEN 'cq_reprovado'     THEN 'cq_reprovado'
    WHEN 'reprovado'        THEN 'cq_reprovado'
    WHEN 'cq_aprovado'      THEN 'cq_aprovado'
    WHEN 'aprovado_cq'      THEN 'cq_aprovado'
    WHEN 'aguardando_cq'    THEN 'aguardando_cq'
    WHEN 'em_cq'            THEN 'aguardando_cq'
    WHEN 'em_producao'      THEN 'em_producao'
    WHEN 'programada'       THEN 'programada'
    ELSE 'aguardando'
  END
$function$
functions.name: fn_cockpit_stage

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_comprovante_entrega_montar_v1(p_entrega_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  e            public.entregas%ROWTYPE;
  v_emitente   jsonb;
  v_destino    jsonb;
  v_os         jsonb;
  v_itens      jsonb;
  v_transporte jsonb;
  v_receb      jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();

  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_UNAUTHENTICATED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT coalesce(public.is_delivery_staff(auth.uid()),false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO e FROM public.entregas WHERE id = p_entrega_id;
  IF e.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_ENTREGA_NAO_ENCONTRADA';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'razao_social', cs.legal_name,
           'nome_fantasia', cs.trade_name,
           'cnpj', cs.cnpj,
           'inscricao_estadual', cs.state_registration,
           'email', cs.fiscal_email,
           'telefone', cs.phone,
           'logradouro', cs.street,
           'numero', cs.number,
           'complemento', cs.complement,
           'bairro', cs.neighborhood,
           'cidade', cs.city,
           'uf', cs.state,
           'cep', cs.postal_code
         )
    INTO v_emitente
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.company_fiscal_settings WHERE organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()) cs
   WHERE cs.is_active
   ORDER BY cs.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
   LIMIT 1;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'cliente_id', c.id,
           'nome', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.razao_social), ''), c.nome),
           'nome_fantasia', c.nome_fantasia,
           'cpf_cnpj', c.cpf_cnpj,
           'telefone', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.telefone), ''), e.destinatario_telefone),
           'email', c.email,
           'cidade', coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.endereco_cidade), ''), c.endereco_municipio),
           'uf', coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.endereco_uf), ''), c.endereco_estado)
         )
    INTO v_destino
    FROM public.clientes c
   WHERE c.id = e.cliente_id;

  v_destino := coalesce(v_destino, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'destinatario_nome', e.destinatario_nome,
    'local_entrega', nullif(btrim(concat_ws(', ',
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_logradouro, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_numero, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_bairro, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_cidade, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_uf, '')), ''))), '')
  );

  -- OS canonica: fluxo padrao (ordens_servico) ou fluxo On-Farm legitimo.
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'os_id', o.id,
           'numero_os', o.numero_os,
           'origem', coalesce(o.origem, 'manual'),
           'tipo', 'ordem_servico'
         )
    INTO v_os
    FROM public.ordens_servico o
   WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_id;

  IF v_os IS NULL AND e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
             'os_id', onf.id,
             'numero_os', onf.numero_os,
             'origem', 'on_farm',
             'tipo', 'ordem_servico_onfarm'
           )
      INTO v_os
      FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm onf
     WHERE onf.id = e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id;
  END IF;

  -- Origem legitima adicional mapeada no dominio: entrega vinculada a pedido
  -- de parceiro (B2B) sem OS de laboratorio. Documentado em
  -- docs/auditorias/comprovante-entrega-fase2.md.
  IF v_os IS NULL AND e.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
             'os_id', po.id,
             'numero_os', po.numero,
             'origem', 'pedido_parceiro',
             'tipo', 'partner_order'
           )
      INTO v_os
      FROM public.partner_orders po
     WHERE po.id = e.partner_order_id;
  END IF;

  -- Itens: caminho canonico por etiqueta
  SELECT jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item->>'lote')
    INTO v_itens
    FROM (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
               'produto', coalesce(pe.produto_nome, pr.nome),
               'microrganismo', coalesce(array_to_string(pe.cepas, ', '), m.nome_cientifico, m.nome),
               'lote', coalesce(pe.lote_codigo, l.codigo_lote),
               'fabricacao', coalesce(pe.fabricado_em::date, l.data_producao),
               'validade', pe.validade_em::date,
               'embalagem', coalesce(eb.tipo_embalagem, pe.unidade),
               'quantidade', coalesce(pe.quantidade_embalagens, 1),
               'volume_unitario_ml', pe.volume,
               'volume_total_ml', coalesce(pe.volume, 0) * coalesce(pe.quantidade_embalagens, 1)
             ) AS item
        FROM public.entrega_etiquetas ee
        JOIN public.produto_etiquetas pe ON pe.id = ee.etiqueta_id
        LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr ON pr.id = pe.produto_id
        LEFT JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id = pe.lote_id
        LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = l.microrganismo_id
        LEFT JOIN public.estoque_embalagens eb ON eb.id = pe.embalagem_id
       WHERE ee.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ee.ativo
    ) s;

  -- Fallback: vinculo direto da entrega (fluxo classico produto_id/lote_id).
  -- Referencias sempre por e2 (linha atual), sem depender da variavel PL/pgSQL.
  IF v_itens IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(v_itens) = 0 THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
             'produto', pr.nome,
             'microrganismo', coalesce(m.nome_cientifico, m.nome),
             'lote', l.codigo_lote,
             'fabricacao', l.data_producao,
             'validade', ep.validade,
             'embalagem', env.tipo_embalagem,
             'quantidade', e2.quantidade_entregue,
             'volume_unitario_ml', coalesce(
               env.volume_por_unidade,
               CASE WHEN coalesce(e2.quantidade_entregue, 0) > 0
                    THEN round(e2.volume_entregue_ml / e2.quantidade_entregue, 2) END),
             'volume_total_ml', coalesce(
               e2.volume_entregue_ml,
               env.volume_por_unidade * e2.quantidade_entregue)
           ))
      INTO v_itens
      FROM public.entregas e2
      LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr
             ON pr.id = coalesce(e2.produto_id,
                                 (SELECT l2.produto_id FROM public.lotes l2 WHERE l2.id = e2.lote_id))
      LEFT JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id = e2.lote_id
      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = l.microrganismo_id
      LEFT JOIN public.estoque_produto ep ON ep.id = e2.estoque_produto_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT en.tipo_embalagem, en.volume_por_unidade
          FROM public.envase en
         WHERE en.lote_id = e2.lote_id
         ORDER BY en.data_envase DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1
      ) env ON true
     WHERE e2.id = p_entrega_id;
  END IF;

  v_transporte := jsonb_build_object(
    'modalidade', e.tipo_entrega,
    'motorista', e.motorista,
    'motorista_telefone', e.motorista_telefone,
    'veiculo', e.veiculo,
    'placa', e.veiculo_placa,
    'veiculo_tipo', e.veiculo_tipo,
    'data_saida', e.data_saida,
    'hora_saida_prevista', e.hora_saida_prevista
  );

  v_receb := jsonb_build_object(
    'recebido_por_nome', coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.recebido_por_nome, '')), ''),
                                  nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.recebedor_nome, '')), '')),
    'documento', coalesce(e.recebido_por_documento, e.recebedor_documento),
    'cargo', coalesce(e.recebido_por_cargo, e.recebedor_cargo),
    'observacoes', e.observacoes_confirmacao,
    'confirmado_em', coalesce(e.confirmada_em, e.entregue_em, e.recebimento_confirmado_em),
    'confirmado_por', coalesce(e.confirmado_por, e.confirmada_por, e.recebimento_confirmado_por),
    'assinatura_tipo', e.assinatura_tipo
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'template_versao', 'comprovante-entrega-v1',
    'entrega_id', e.id,
    'entrega_status', e.status::text,
    'emitente', coalesce(v_emitente, '{}'::jsonb),
    'destinatario', coalesce(v_destino, '{}'::jsonb),
    'ordem_servico', v_os,
    'itens', coalesce(v_itens, '[]'::jsonb),
    'transporte', v_transporte,
    'recebimento', v_receb
  );
END
$function$
functions.name: fn_comprovante_entrega_montar_v1

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_owner_internal_partner_readable(p_partner uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  -- Read-only predicate. Internal staff (administrador/gestor_comercial/financeiro) of the active organization that
  -- commercially owns an active partner. External roles or active partner links deny. Reads no partner_orders (no recursion).
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND p_partner IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = auth.uid()
                    AND r.role::text IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico','cliente_produtor'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_users pu WHERE pu.user_id = auth.uid() AND pu.revoked_at IS NULL)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = auth.uid()
                AND r.role::text IN ('administrador','gestor_comercial','financeiro'))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa
                JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                     AND owner.ativo IS TRUE AND owner.status = 'ativa'
                WHERE pa.id = p_partner AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id = platform_private.h15_actor_organization())
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_set_organization_status(_org uuid, _status text, _motivo text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_financial_inconsistencies()
 RETURNS TABLE(code text, severity text, entity_type text, entity_id uuid, description text, recommended_action text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();

  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado' USING ERRCODE='insufficient_privilege';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  -- 1. Entrega BILLED sem receivable_id
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_BILLED_NO_AR'::text, 'alta'::text, 'entregas'::text, e.id,
         'Entrega marcada como faturada sem título financeiro vinculado.'::text,
         'Reprocessar faturamento ou reverter status para PENDING_BILLING.'::text
    FROM public.entregas e
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'BILLED' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 2. Entrega NOT_BILLABLE com receivable_id
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_NOT_BILLABLE_WITH_AR', 'alta', 'entregas', e.id,
         'Entrega marcada como sem cobrança porém possui título financeiro.',
         'Revisar status financeiro da entrega ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.entregas e
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'NOT_BILLABLE' AND e.receivable_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 3. Entrega com receivable_id apontando para AR inexistente
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_AR_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'entregas', e.id,
         'Entrega referencia um título que não existe mais.',
         'Limpar receivable_id ou recriar o título via faturamento.'
    FROM public.entregas e
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = e.receivable_id
   WHERE e.receivable_id IS NOT NULL AND ar.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 4. AR sem parcelas
  SELECT 'AR_NO_INSTALLMENTS', 'alta', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Conta a receber sem parcelas geradas.',
         'Gerar parcelas manualmente ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
   WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
   GROUP BY ar.id
  HAVING count(ari.id) = 0

  UNION ALL
  -- 5. AP sem parcelas
  SELECT 'AP_NO_INSTALLMENTS', 'alta', 'accounts_payable', ap.id,
         'Conta a pagar sem parcelas geradas.',
         'Gerar parcelas manualmente ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.accounts_payable ap
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_payable_installments api ON api.payable_id = ap.id
   WHERE ap.status <> 'CANCELED'
   GROUP BY ap.id
  HAVING count(api.id) = 0

  UNION ALL
  -- 6. AR PAID com parcela ainda em aberto
  SELECT 'AR_PAID_OPEN_INSTALLMENT', 'critica', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Título marcado como PAGO mas possui parcela em aberto/parcial/vencida.',
         'Reprocessar status do título.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.status = 'PAID'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments ari
        WHERE ari.receivable_id = ar.id AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 7. AP PAID com parcela ainda em aberto
  SELECT 'AP_PAID_OPEN_INSTALLMENT', 'critica', 'accounts_payable', ap.id,
         'Título marcado como PAGO mas possui parcela em aberto/parcial/vencida.',
         'Reprocessar status do título.'
    FROM public.accounts_payable ap
   WHERE ap.status = 'PAID'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable_installments api
        WHERE api.payable_id = ap.id AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 8. Conta CANCELED com pagamento ativo (não estorno)
  SELECT 'AR_CANCELED_WITH_PAYMENT', 'alta', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Título cancelado possui baixas ativas não estornadas.',
         'Estornar pagamentos antes de manter o cancelamento.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.status = 'CANCELED'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments ari
        JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.installment_id = ari.id
       WHERE ari.receivable_id = ar.id AND COALESCE(rp.is_reversal,false) = false
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.receivable_payments rp2 WHERE rp2.reversed_payment_id = rp.id)
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 9. Recibo emitido para pagamento de estorno
  SELECT 'RECEIPT_FOR_REVERSAL', 'alta', 'financial_receipts', fr.id,
         'Recibo emitido sobre um lançamento de estorno.',
         'Cancelar o recibo.'
    FROM public.financial_receipts fr
    JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.id = fr.payment_id
   WHERE fr.status = 'ISSUED' AND rp.is_reversal = true

  UNION ALL
  -- 10. Recibo emitido para pagamento inexistente
  SELECT 'RECEIPT_PAYMENT_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'financial_receipts', fr.id,
         'Recibo aponta para pagamento inexistente.',
         'Cancelar o recibo ou restaurar o pagamento.'
    FROM public.financial_receipts fr
    LEFT JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.id = fr.payment_id
   WHERE fr.status = 'ISSUED' AND fr.payment_id IS NOT NULL AND rp.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 11. NF vinculada a AR inexistente
  SELECT 'FISCAL_INVOICE_AR_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'fiscal_invoices', fi.id,
         'Nota fiscal vinculada a um título que não existe.',
         'Religar a NF a um título válido ou cancelá-la.'
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fi
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = fi.receivable_id
   WHERE fi.receivable_id IS NOT NULL AND ar.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 12. Documento financeiro órfão (owner_id sem registro)
  SELECT 'FINANCIAL_DOC_ORPHAN', 'media', 'financial_documents', fd.id,
         'Documento financeiro vinculado a um registro inexistente ('||fd.owner_type||').',
         'Excluir logicamente ou religar a entidade correta.'
    FROM public.financial_documents fd
   WHERE fd.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND (
       (fd.owner_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'PAYABLE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'FISCAL_INVOICE' AND public.h15_invoice_access(fd.owner_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fiscal_invoices WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type IN ('PAYMENT_RECEIVABLE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.receivable_payments WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type IN ('PAYMENT_PAYABLE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.payable_payments WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'FINANCIAL_RECEIPT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.financial_receipts WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 13. Entrega faturada duplicada (mesma entrega com >1 AR)
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_DUPLICATED_AR', 'critica', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Mais de um título financeiro foi gerado para a mesma entrega.',
         'Cancelar os títulos extras.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.origin_type = 'DELIVERY'
     AND ar.origin_id IN (
       SELECT origin_id FROM public.accounts_receivable
        WHERE origin_type = 'DELIVERY' AND origin_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'
        GROUP BY origin_id HAVING count(*) > 1
     )

  ORDER BY 2, 1, 4;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fiscal_item_base(_components jsonb, _ctx jsonb)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v numeric := 0; c text;
BEGIN
  IF _components IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(_components) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_TAX_RULE_INCOMPLETE: regra sem componentes de base declarados (base_components).'
      USING HINT = 'Declare explicitamente PRODUTO/FRETE/SEGURO/OUTRAS_DESPESAS/DESCONTO/IPI/ICMS_ST conforme base legal publicada.';
  END IF;
  FOR c IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(_components) LOOP
    v := v + CASE c
      WHEN 'PRODUTO'          THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'produto')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'FRETE'            THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'frete')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'SEGURO'           THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'seguro')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'OUTRAS_DESPESAS'  THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'outras')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'DESCONTO'         THEN -coalesce((_ctx->>'desconto')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'IPI'              THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'ipi')::numeric,0)
      WHEN 'ICMS_ST'          THEN coalesce((_ctx->>'icmsSt')::numeric,0)
      ELSE 0 END;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN public.fn_fiscal_round(v);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6b_payment_fingerprint(p_kind text, p_installment_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS text

 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(extensions.digest(

      public.fn_h6b_num(COALESCE((p_payload->>'amount_received')::numeric,
                                 (p_payload->>'amount_paid')::numeric)),

      public.fn_h6b_num((p_payload->>'interest_amount')::numeric),

      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'payment_method_id',''), '-'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'bank_account_id',''), '-'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'payment_date',''), '-'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'notes',''), '-'),
      COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'has_receipt',''), '-')
    ), 'sha256'), 'hex');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_upsert_alerta_operacional(p_tipo text, p_origem text, p_titulo text, p_descricao text, p_gravidade text, p_referencia_tabela text, p_referencia_id uuid, p_cliente_id uuid, p_fazenda_id uuid, p_talhao_id uuid, p_consultor_id uuid, p_os_id uuid, p_registro_consultor_id uuid, p_solicitacao_id uuid, p_lote_id uuid, p_entrega_id uuid, p_proxima_acao text, p_metadata jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_chave text;
  v_id uuid;
BEGIN
  v_chave := concat_ws('|',
    p_tipo, p_origem,
    coalesce(p_referencia_tabela,''), coalesce(p_referencia_id::text,''),
    coalesce(p_cliente_id::text,''), coalesce(p_fazenda_id::text,''),
    coalesce(p_consultor_id::text,''), coalesce(p_os_id::text,''));

  UPDATE public.alertas_operacionais
     SET descricao = p_descricao, gravidade = p_gravidade, titulo = p_titulo,
         proxima_acao = p_proxima_acao, metadata = coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb),
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE chave_dedupe = v_chave AND status IN ('aberto','lido','reaberto')
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_id; END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_id FROM public.alertas_operacionais
   WHERE chave_dedupe = v_chave AND status = 'ignorado'
     AND ignorado_em > now() - interval '1 day' LIMIT 1;
  IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_id; END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_id FROM public.alertas_operacionais
   WHERE chave_dedupe = v_chave AND status = 'resolvido'
     AND resolvido_em > now() - (CASE p_gravidade
        WHEN 'critica' THEN interval '3 days'
        WHEN 'alta' THEN interval '7 days'
        ELSE interval '15 days' END)
   LIMIT 1;
  IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_id; END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.alertas_operacionais(
    tipo, origem, titulo, descricao, gravidade, status,
    cliente_id, fazenda_id, talhao_id, consultor_id,
    os_id, registro_consultor_id, solicitacao_id, lote_id, entrega_id,
    referencia_tabela, referencia_id, proxima_acao, metadata, chave_dedupe
  ) VALUES (
    p_tipo, p_origem, p_titulo, p_descricao, p_gravidade, 'aberto',
    p_cliente_id, p_fazenda_id, p_talhao_id, p_consultor_id,
    p_os_id, p_registro_consultor_id, p_solicitacao_id, p_lote_id, p_entrega_id,
    p_referencia_tabela, p_referencia_id, p_proxima_acao, coalesce(p_metadata,'{}'::jsonb), v_chave
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  RETURN v_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_fail_org_admin_provisioning(p_job_id uuid, p_lease_token uuid, p_error_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_role text;
BEGIN
  v_role := coalesce(nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role',true),''),
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims',true),'')::jsonb->>'role','');
  IF v_role<>'service_role' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.platform_org_admin_invites SET status='falhou',lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,
    last_error_code=left(coalesce(p_error_code,'unknown'),40),updated_at=now()
  WHERE id=p_job_id AND status='processando' AND lease_token=p_lease_token;
  RETURN FOUND;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_finalize_org_admin_provisioning(p_job_id uuid, p_lease_token uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_role text;
  j public.platform_org_admin_invites%ROWTYPE;
  v_auth_email text;
  v_origin text;
BEGIN
  v_role := coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb->>'role',
    ''
  );

  IF v_role <> 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_authorization_failed'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO j
    FROM public.platform_org_admin_invites
   WHERE id = p_job_id
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_finalize_internal_error'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF j.status = 'ativo' AND j.user_id = p_user_id THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'status', 'ativo',
      'idempotent', true,
      'user_id', j.user_id
    );
  END IF;

  IF j.status <> 'processando'
     OR j.lease_token IS DISTINCT FROM p_lease_token
     OR j.lease_expires_at IS NULL
     OR j.lease_expires_at <= clock_timestamp() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_stale_lease'
      USING ERRCODE = '55P03';
  END IF;

  SELECT lower(u.email), coalesce(u.raw_app_meta_data->>'provisioning_request_id', '')
    INTO v_auth_email, v_origin
    FROM auth.users AS u
   WHERE u.id = p_user_id;

  IF v_auth_email IS NULL
     OR v_auth_email <> lower(j.email)
     OR v_origin <> j.request_id::text THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_auth_metadata_mismatch'
      USING ERRCODE = '23505';
  END IF;

  IF public.is_platform_superadmin(p_user_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_authorization_failed'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
         FROM public.profiles AS p
        WHERE p.user_id = p_user_id
          AND p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
          AND p.organization_id <> j.organization_id
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_profile_tenant_conflict'
      USING ERRCODE = '23505';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
         FROM public.user_roles AS r
        WHERE r.user_id = p_user_id
          AND r.role <> 'administrador'::public.app_role
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_authorization_failed'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.profiles AS p (
      user_id,
      nome,
      email,
      telefone,
      cargo,
      cpf_cnpj,
      ativo,
      organization_id,
      senha_provisoria
    )
    VALUES (
      p_user_id,
      j.nome,
      j.email,
      j.telefone,
      CASE
        WHEN j.responsavel_principal THEN 'Responsável Principal'
        ELSE 'Administrador'
      END,
      j.cpf_cnpj,
      true,
      j.organization_id,
      true
    )
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
       SET nome = CASE
                    WHEN nullif(btrim(p.nome), '') IS NOT NULL THEN p.nome
                    ELSE excluded.nome
                  END,
           email = CASE
                     WHEN nullif(btrim(coalesce(p.email, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN p.email
                     ELSE excluded.email
                   END,
           telefone = coalesce(p.telefone, excluded.telefone),
           cargo = coalesce(p.cargo, excluded.cargo),
           cpf_cnpj = coalesce(p.cpf_cnpj, excluded.cpf_cnpj),
           ativo = true,
           organization_id = excluded.organization_id,
           senha_provisoria = true
     WHERE p.organization_id IS NULL
        OR p.organization_id = excluded.organization_id;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_profile_tenant_conflict'
        USING ERRCODE = '23505';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role)
    VALUES (p_user_id, 'administrador'::public.app_role)
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, role) DO NOTHING;

    INSERT INTO platform_private.provisional_password_state (user_id)
    VALUES (p_user_id)
    ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
      SET desde = now(), expires_at = now()+interval '24 hours', pwd_digest = NULL;

    IF j.responsavel_principal THEN
      PERFORM platform_private.issue_ticket('org_write', j.organization_id);
      UPDATE public.organizations
         SET responsavel_user_id = p_user_id,
             responsavel_definido_em = now(),
             updated_at = now()
       WHERE id = j.organization_id;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.platform_org_admin_invites
       SET user_id = p_user_id,
           status = 'pendente',
           auth_created_at = coalesce(auth_created_at, now()),
           lease_token = NULL,
           lease_expires_at = NULL,
           last_error_code = NULL,
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = j.id
       AND status = 'processando'
       AND lease_token = p_lease_token;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_stale_lease'
        USING ERRCODE = '55P03';
    END IF;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN integrity_constraint_violation THEN
      IF SQLERRM IN (
        'platform_profile_tenant_conflict',
        'platform_auth_metadata_mismatch'
      ) THEN
        RAISE;
      END IF;
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'platform_database_constraint'
        USING ERRCODE = '23000';
  END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'status', 'pendente',
    'idempotent', false,
    'user_id', p_user_id
  );
END
$function$

 IF v_uid IS NULL OR v_org IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id=_cliente_id AND c.organization_id=v_org) OR NOT(public.is_operational_staff(v_uid) OR public.can_user_access_cliente(v_uid,_cliente_id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cadastro_client_scope_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

 'parceiros',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_accounts WHERE client_id=_cliente_id),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_aging_detalhado(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(faixa text, qtd_titulos integer, valor numeric, qtd_parceiros integer, pct_carteira numeric, valor_medio_parceiro numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_total numeric;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id, ari.id AS inst_id,
      (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
      GREATEST(0, (CURRENT_DATE - ari.due_date)) AS dias_atraso
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR ar.issue_date >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR ar.issue_date <= p_to)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR ari.status = p_status)
  ),
  classed AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 30 THEN '0-30'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        ELSE '90+'
      END AS bucket
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(saldo),0) INTO v_total FROM classed;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id,
      (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
      GREATEST(0, (CURRENT_DATE - ari.due_date)) AS dias_atraso
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR ar.issue_date >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR ar.issue_date <= p_to)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR ari.status = p_status)
  ),
  classed AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 30 THEN '0-30'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        ELSE '90+'
      END AS bucket
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT
    b AS faixa,
    COALESCE(COUNT(c.*),0)::int AS qtd_titulos,
    COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)::numeric AS valor,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id),0)::int AS qtd_parceiros,
    CASE WHEN v_total > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)/v_total)*100,2) ELSE 0 END AS pct_carteira,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)/COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id),2) ELSE 0 END AS valor_medio_parceiro
  FROM (VALUES ('0-30'),('31-60'),('61-90'),('90+')) AS f(b)
  LEFT JOIN classed c ON c.bucket = f.b
  GROUP BY f.b
  ORDER BY CASE f.b WHEN '0-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_portal_partner_financial()
 RETURNS TABLE(partner_order_id uuid, numero text, receivable_id uuid, total numeric, vencimento date, financial_status text, payment_method text, ar_status text, installments jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    po.id, po.numero, ar.id, po.total, po.payment_due_date, po.financial_status, po.payment_method, ar.status,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'numero', i.installment_number, 'vencimento', i.due_date,
        'valor', i.original_amount, 'recebido', i.received_amount, 'status', i.status
      ) ORDER BY i.installment_number)
      FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id = ar.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  JOIN public.partner_order_financial_links l ON l.partner_order_id = po.id
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = l.receivable_id
  WHERE po.partner_id IN (SELECT partner_id FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id = v_uid)
  ORDER BY po.created_at DESC;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_commercial_context()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid; pid uuid; rs text[]; result jsonb; BEGIN
 org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
 SELECT partner_id INTO pid FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u;
 IF NOT public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(u,pid) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(role::text ORDER BY role::text) INTO rs FROM public.user_roles WHERE user_id=u;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_MULTIPROFILE_V1','actor_id',u,'tenant_id',org,
 'organization_id',org,'partner_id',pid,'commercial_owner_organization_id',org,'external_roles',rs,
 'role',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'parceiro_b2b' ELSE 'parceiro_b2b_tecnico' END,
 'papel',CASE WHEN 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs) THEN 'gestor' ELSE 'tecnico' END,'mode','commercial_owner',
 'manager', 'parceiro_b2b'=ANY(rs),'technician','parceiro_b2b_tecnico'=ANY(rs),
 'producer_links_valid',platform_private.c2_producer_links(u,org),
 'profile_stamp',(SELECT updated_at FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=u),
 'link_version',(SELECT version FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id=u));
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_provisioning_preflight(p_partner uuid, p_role text, p_papel text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); org uuid;
BEGIN
 org:=public.h15_actor_organization();
 IF u IS NULL OR org IS NULL OR NOT platform_private.platform_actor_access_ready(u)
 OR NOT public.has_role(u,'administrador'::public.app_role) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'b2b_provisioning_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 IF p_role NOT IN ('parceiro_b2b','parceiro_b2b_tecnico') OR p_role IS NULL
 OR p_papel IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN p_role='parceiro_b2b_tecnico' THEN 'tecnico' ELSE 'gestor' END)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts p WHERE p.id=p_partner
   AND p.commercial_owner_organization_id=org AND p.ativo IS TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations o WHERE o.id=org AND o.ativo IS TRUE AND o.status='ativa')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(u) e WHERE e.feature_key='catalogo_precos') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'b2b_provisioning_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('organization_id',org,'partner_id',p_partner,'role',p_role,'papel',p_papel,
 'enabled',false,'reason','b2b_same_tenant_channels_unverified');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_commercial_own_orders()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE c jsonb; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 c:=platform_private.b2b_commercial_context();
 IF c IS NULL OR c->>'role'<>'parceiro_b2b' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'b2b_own_orders_forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',q.id,'numero',q.numero,
  'status',q.status,'created_at',q.created_at) ORDER BY q.created_at DESC,q.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO result FROM (
  SELECT o.id,o.numero,o.status,o.created_at FROM public.partner_orders o
  JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=o.partner_id
  WHERE o.partner_id=(c->>'partner_id')::uuid
   AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id=(c->>'commercial_owner_organization_id')::uuid
   AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id LIMIT 100
 ) q;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('partner_id',c->>'partner_id','orders',result);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_deliveries_billing_status(_from date, _to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(delivery_id uuid, customer_name text, delivery_date date, total_value numeric, billed boolean, receivable_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _from IS NULL OR _to IS NULL OR _to < _from THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT e.id,
         COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'),
         COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida),
         COALESCE(ar.total_amount, 0)::numeric,
         (ar.id IS NOT NULL),
         ar.id
  FROM entregas e
  JOIN clientes c ON c.id = e.cliente_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar
         ON ar.id = e.receivable_id
        AND ar.customer_id = e.cliente_id
        AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
  WHERE COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida) BETWEEN _from AND _to
  ORDER BY COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida) DESC, e.id;
END;$function$
functions.name: get_report_deliveries_billing_status

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_nfe_pending(_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(receivable_id uuid, customer_name text, description text, total_amount numeric, issue_date date, fiscal_invoice_status text, fiscal_invoice_required boolean, origin_type text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT ar.id, COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'), ar.description,
         ar.total_amount, ar.issue_date,
         COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_status, 'PENDING'),
         COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_required, false),
         COALESCE(ar.origin_type, 'MANUAL')
  FROM accounts_receivable ar
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
  WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND (ar.fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
         OR (COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_required,false)=true
             AND COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_status,'PENDING') <> 'ISSUED'))
  ORDER BY ar.issue_date DESC NULLS LAST;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_cockpit_metricas_v1()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT v.*, public.fn_cockpit_stage(v.status_esteira_oficial) AS stage
      FROM public.vw_esteira_laboratorio v
     WHERE v.status_os <> 'finalizada'
  ),
  sem_prog AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS n
      FROM public.ordens_servico os
     WHERE os.status::text = 'aberta'
       AND NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao pp
          WHERE pp.ordem_servico_id = os.id
       )
  ),
  sem_prog_onfarm AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS n
      FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm os
     WHERE os.status::text = 'aberta'
       AND NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM public.programacao_producao pp
          WHERE pp.ordem_servico_onfarm_id = os.id
       )
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total',              (SELECT count(*) FROM base),
    'demandas',           (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage IN ('aguardando','programada')),
    'producao',           (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'em_producao'),
    'vol_producao',       (SELECT coalesce(sum(volume_solicitado_l),0) FROM base WHERE stage = 'em_producao'),
    'aguardando_cq',      (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'aguardando_cq'),
    'vol_cq',             (SELECT coalesce(sum(volume_solicitado_l),0) FROM base WHERE stage = 'aguardando_cq'),
    'aprovados',          (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE status_lote::text = 'aprovado'),
    'reprovados',         (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE status_lote::text = 'reprovado'),
    'envase_pendente',    (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'cq_aprovado'),
    'em_envase',          (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'em_envase'),
    'estoque_disponivel', (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'estoque_disponivel'),
    'estoque_reservado',  (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'estoque_reservado'),
    'em_entrega',         (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'em_entrega'),
    'entregues',          (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'entregue'),
    'atrasadas',          (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE atrasado),
    'bloqueadas',         (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE coalesce(array_length(bloqueios,1),0) > 0),
    'os_sem_programacao', (SELECT n FROM sem_prog) + (SELECT n FROM sem_prog_onfarm)
  )
$function$
functions.name: rpc_cockpit_metricas_v1

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_cockpit_metricas_v2(p_busca text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_stages text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_origens text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_prioridades text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_atrasado boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_de date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_ate date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT v.*, public.fn_cockpit_stage(v.status_esteira_oficial) AS stage
      FROM public.vw_esteira_laboratorio v
      LEFT JOIN public.programacao_producao pp ON pp.id = v.programacao_id
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.user_id = pp.responsavel_id
     WHERE v.status_os <> 'finalizada'
       AND (p_origens IS NULL OR v.origem_os = ANY (p_origens))
       AND (p_prioridades IS NULL OR v.prioridade::text = ANY (p_prioridades))
       AND (p_atrasado IS NULL OR v.atrasado = p_atrasado)
       AND (p_de IS NULL OR v.created_at::date >= p_de)
       AND (p_ate IS NULL OR v.created_at::date <= p_ate)
       AND (p_stages IS NULL OR public.fn_cockpit_stage(v.status_esteira_oficial) = ANY (p_stages))
       AND (
         nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_busca, '')), '') IS NULL
         OR concat_ws(' ', v.numero_os, v.codigo_lote, v.cliente_nome, v.partner_nome,
                      v.titular_nome, v.fazenda_nome, v.talhao_nome, v.produto_nome,
                      v.microrganismo_nome, pp.responsavel, pr.nome)
            ILIKE '%' || btrim(p_busca) || '%'
       )
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'escopo_filtrado',    true,
    'total',              (SELECT count(*) FROM base),
    'demandas',           (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage IN ('aguardando','programada')),
    'producao',           (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'em_producao'),
    'vol_producao',       (SELECT coalesce(sum(volume_solicitado_l),0) FROM base WHERE stage = 'em_producao'),
    'aguardando_cq',      (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'aguardando_cq'),
    'vol_cq',             (SELECT coalesce(sum(volume_solicitado_l),0) FROM base WHERE stage = 'aguardando_cq'),
    'aprovados',          (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE status_lote::text = 'aprovado'),
    'reprovados',         (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE status_lote::text = 'reprovado'),
    'envase_pendente',    (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'cq_aprovado'),
    'em_envase',          (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'em_envase'),
    'estoque_disponivel', (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'estoque_disponivel'),
    'estoque_reservado',  (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'estoque_reservado'),
    'em_entrega',         (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'em_entrega'),
    'entregues',          (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE stage = 'entregue'),
    'atrasadas',          (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE atrasado),
    'bloqueadas',         (SELECT count(*) FROM base WHERE coalesce(array_length(bloqueios,1),0) > 0)
  )
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(cliente_id uuid, nome text, razao_social text, nome_fantasia text, tipo_pessoa text, documento_mascarado text, telefone text, cidade text, estado text, assignment_type text, can_create_simulation boolean, can_monitor boolean, assigned_at timestamp with time zone, ultima_simulacao_at timestamp with time zone, total_simulacoes bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE org uuid:=public.h15_actor_organization(); BEGIN
IF NOT platform_private.b2b_internal_commercial_actor() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'b2b_client_assignments_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
IF p_search IS NOT NULL AND length(p_search)>200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_search' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.user_id=p_user_id AND p.organization_id=org AND p.ativo IS TRUE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
RETURN QUERY SELECT c.id,c.nome,c.razao_social,c.nome_fantasia,c.tipo_pessoa::text,CASE WHEN c.cpf_cnpj IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN length(c.cpf_cnpj)>=4 THEN repeat('*',greatest(length(c.cpf_cnpj)-4,0))||right(c.cpf_cnpj,4) ELSE '****' END,c.telefone,c.endereco_municipio,c.endereco_estado,puc.assignment_type,puc.can_create_simulation,puc.can_monitor,puc.assigned_at,(SELECT max(ps.created_at) FROM public.partner_simulations ps WHERE ps.cliente_id=c.id AND ps.partner_id=puc.partner_id AND ps.created_by=puc.user_id),(SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_simulations ps WHERE ps.cliente_id=c.id AND ps.partner_id=puc.partner_id AND ps.created_by=puc.user_id) FROM public.partner_user_clients puc JOIN public.clientes c ON c.id=puc.cliente_id JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=puc.partner_id WHERE puc.active IS TRUE AND (p_user_id IS NULL OR puc.user_id=p_user_id) AND c.organization_id=org AND pa.commercial_owner_organization_id=org AND pa.ativo IS TRUE AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL AND platform_private.b2b_assignment_identity_coherent(puc.user_id,puc.partner_id,org) AND (p_search IS NULL OR p_search='' OR coalesce(c.nome,'') ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR coalesce(c.razao_social,'') ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR coalesce(c.nome_fantasia,'') ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR coalesce(c.endereco_municipio,'') ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%'); END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_commercial_alerts()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador') OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(
 'pedidos_aguardando_aprovacao',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.status::text IN ('solicitado','em_analise_comercial') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa WHERE pa.id=po.partner_id)),
 'pedidos_aguardando_ajuste',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_orders po WHERE po.status::text='aguardando_ajuste_comercial' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_accounts pa WHERE pa.id=po.partner_id)),
 'campanhas_vencendo','[]'::jsonb,
 'campanhas_disponiveis',false,
 'campanhas_motivo','campaign_owner_unverified',
 'tabelas_vencendo',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT partner_id,product_id,price_table_name,valid_until FROM public.partner_product_prices WHERE is_current AND valid_until BETWEEN current_date AND current_date+15 ORDER BY valid_until,id LIMIT 50) t),
 'parceiros_sem_tabela',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT pa.id,pa.razao_social FROM public.partner_accounts pa WHERE pa.ativo AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_product_prices ppp WHERE ppp.partner_id=pa.id AND ppp.is_current AND ppp.ativo) ORDER BY pa.id LIMIT 50) p),
 'parceiros_sem_compras_30d',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT pa.id,pa.razao_social,(SELECT max(created_at) FROM public.partner_orders WHERE partner_id=pa.id) ultima_compra FROM public.partner_accounts pa WHERE pa.ativo AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders WHERE partner_id=pa.id AND created_at>now()-interval '30 days') ORDER BY pa.id LIMIT 50) p),
 'parceiros_sem_compras_60d',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT pa.id,pa.razao_social,(SELECT max(created_at) FROM public.partner_orders WHERE partner_id=pa.id) ultima_compra FROM public.partner_accounts pa WHERE pa.ativo AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders WHERE partner_id=pa.id AND created_at>now()-interval '60 days') ORDER BY pa.id LIMIT 50) p),
 'mensagens_nao_respondidas',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_messages m WHERE m.status IN ('nao_lida','lida') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_orders po JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id=po.partner_id WHERE po.id=m.order_id))
 );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_cockpit_listar_esteira_v1(p_busca text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_stages text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_origens text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_prioridades text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_atrasado boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_de date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_ate date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_incluir_finalizadas boolean DEFAULT false, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH base AS (
 SELECT v.os_id,v.origem_os,v.numero_os,v.cliente_id,v.cliente_nome,v.fazenda_id,v.fazenda_nome,v.talhao_id,v.talhao_nome,
 v.produto_id,v.produto_nome,v.microrganismo_id,v.microrganismo_nome,v.partner_id,v.partner_numero,v.partner_nome,v.titular_nome,v.titular_tipo,
 v.prioridade,v.volume_solicitado_l,v.status_os,CASE WHEN v.status_os IN ('aberta','aprovada') THEN v.status_os ELSE v.status_esteira_oficial END status_esteira_oficial,public.fn_cockpit_stage(CASE WHEN v.status_os IN ('aberta','aprovada') THEN v.status_os ELSE v.status_esteira_oficial END) stage,
 v.programacao_id,v.data_programada,v.lote_id,v.codigo_lote,v.status_lote,v.cq_resultado,v.envase_id,v.estoque_id,v.estoque_reservado_id,
 v.entrega_id,v.entrega_status,v.atrasado,v.bloqueios,v.pode_finalizar,v.proxima_acao,v.created_at,
 pp.responsavel_id,pr.nome responsavel_nome
 FROM public.vw_esteira_laboratorio v
 LEFT JOIN public.programacao_producao pp ON pp.id=v.programacao_id AND pp.organization_id=platform_private.h15_actor_organization()
 LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.user_id=pp.responsavel_id AND pr.organization_id=pp.organization_id AND pr.ativo IS TRUE
 WHERE (p_incluir_finalizadas IS TRUE OR v.status_os<>'finalizada')
 AND (p_origens IS NULL OR v.origem_os=ANY(p_origens))
 AND (p_prioridades IS NULL OR v.prioridade::text=ANY(p_prioridades))
 AND (p_atrasado IS NULL OR v.atrasado=p_atrasado)
 AND (p_de IS NULL OR v.created_at::date>=p_de) AND (p_ate IS NULL OR v.created_at::date<=p_ate)
 AND (p_stages IS NULL OR public.fn_cockpit_stage(CASE WHEN v.status_os IN ('aberta','aprovada') THEN v.status_os ELSE v.status_esteira_oficial END)=ANY(p_stages))
 AND (nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_busca,'')),'') IS NULL OR concat_ws(' ',v.numero_os,v.codigo_lote,v.cliente_nome,v.partner_nome,v.titular_nome,v.fazenda_nome,v.talhao_nome,v.produto_nome,v.microrganismo_nome,pr.nome) ILIKE '%'||btrim(p_busca)||'%')
 ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('total_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM base),'limit',greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,50),200)),
 'offset',greatest(0,coalesce(p_offset,0)), 'items',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY t.atrasado DESC NULLS LAST,t.created_at DESC,t.origem_os,t.os_id)
 FROM (SELECT * FROM base ORDER BY atrasado DESC NULLS LAST,created_at DESC,origem_os,os_id
 LIMIT greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,50),200)) OFFSET greatest(0,coalesce(p_offset,0))) t),'[]'::jsonb));
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

   OR COALESCE((auth.jwt()->>'iat') ~ '^[0-9]{1,10}$',false) IS FALSE THEN false
 ELSE CASE WHEN (auth.jwt()->>'iat')::bigint <= 0 THEN false
 ELSE platform_private.h15_actor_organization() IS NOT NULL

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.h15_fiscal_audit_access(p_table text, p_record uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF public.h15_actor_organization() IS NULL OR p_record IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  RETURN CASE p_table
    WHEN 'company_fiscal_settings' THEN public.h15_company_access(p_record)
    WHEN 'fiscal_invoices' THEN public.h15_invoice_access(p_record)
    WHEN 'fiscal_events' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_events e WHERE e.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(e.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_xml_runs' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_xml_runs r WHERE r.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(r.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_sefaz_transmissions' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_sefaz_transmissions t WHERE t.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(t.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_protocoled_documents' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_protocoled_documents d WHERE d.id=p_record AND public.h15_invoice_access(d.fiscal_invoice_id))
    WHEN 'fiscal_certificates' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_certificates c WHERE c.id=p_record AND public.h15_company_access(c.company_settings_id))
    ELSE false
  END;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_listar_atendimentos_tecnicos_v1(p_aba text DEFAULT 'todos'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_is_admin boolean;
  v_is_tech boolean;
  v_page integer := GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page,1),1);
  v_size integer := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page_size,20),1),100);
  v_aba text := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_aba),''),'todos'));
  v_q text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search,'')),'');
  v_total bigint := 0;
  v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  c_abas constant text[] := ARRAY['todos','demandas','ocorrencias','andamento','aguardando','monitoramento','concluidos'];
BEGIN
  IF NOT (v_aba = ANY (c_abas)) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'invalid_tab',
      'items','[]'::jsonb,'total',0,'page',v_page,'page_size',v_size,'has_more',false);
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.technical_actor_ready(v_uid) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error','unauthenticated',
      'items','[]'::jsonb,'total',0,'page',v_page,'page_size',v_size,'has_more',false);
  END IF;

  v_is_admin := public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador') OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor');
  v_is_tech := EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
    WHERE ur.user_id = v_uid AND ur.role IN ('tecnico_agronomo','consultor_tecnico')
  );

  IF NOT (v_is_admin OR v_is_tech) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error','forbidden',
      'items','[]'::jsonb,'total',0,'page',v_page,'page_size',v_size,'has_more',false);
  END IF;

  WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      'visita'::text AS kind,
      r.id,
      r.codigo_visita AS codigo,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(r.objetivo_visita,''), NULLIF(r.problema_principal,''), 'Atendimento técnico') AS titulo,
      r.status::text AS status,
      r.origem_atendimento AS origem,
      c.nome AS cliente_nome,
      f.nome AS fazenda_nome,
      t.nome AS talhao_nome,
      cu.nome AS cultura_nome,
      r.tipo_visita::text AS tipo,
      r.urgencia::text AS urgencia,
      pr.nome AS responsavel_nome,
      r.data_proxima_visita::timestamptz AS data_prevista,
      CASE
        WHEN r.status = 'rascunho' AND r.cultura_id IS NULL THEN 'Informar cultura'
        WHEN r.status IN ('rascunho','em_andamento') THEN 'Continuar preenchimento'
        WHEN r.status = 'enviado_aprovacao' THEN 'Aguardando aprovação'
        WHEN r.status = 'reprovado' THEN 'Revisar e reenviar'
        WHEN r.status IN ('aprovado','convertido_os') AND r.data_proxima_visita IS NOT NULL THEN 'Retorno programado'
        ELSE 'Sem ação pendente'
      END AS proxima_acao,
      COALESCE(r.data_vistoria::timestamptz, r.created_at) AS data_ref,
      (r.status IN ('rascunho','em_andamento','reprovado')
        AND public.can_manage_technical_visit(v_uid, r.id)) AS can_edit,
      '/app/visita/' || r.id::text AS next_route,
      CASE
        WHEN r.status IN ('rascunho','em_andamento') THEN 'andamento'
        WHEN r.status IN ('enviado_aprovacao','reprovado') THEN 'aguardando'
        WHEN r.status IN ('aprovado','convertido_os') AND r.data_proxima_visita IS NOT NULL THEN 'monitoramento'
        ELSE 'concluidos'
      END AS bucket
    FROM public.registros_consultor r
    LEFT JOIN public.clientes c  ON c.id = r.cliente_id
    LEFT JOIN public.fazendas f  ON f.id = r.fazenda_id
    LEFT JOIN public.talhoes  t  ON t.id = r.talhao_id
    LEFT JOIN public.culturas cu ON cu.id = r.cultura_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.user_id = r.consultor_responsavel
    WHERE public.can_view_technical_visit(v_uid, r.id)
      AND (v_q IS NULL OR (
        COALESCE(r.codigo_visita,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
        OR COALESCE(r.objetivo_visita,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
        OR COALESCE(r.problema_principal,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
        OR COALESCE(c.nome,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
        OR COALESCE(f.nome,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
      ))

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      'demanda'::text,
      s.id,
      s.numero_solicitacao,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(s.descricao,''), s.tipo_demanda, 'Demanda do produtor'),
      s.status,
      'solicitacao_produtor',
      c.nome, f.nome, t.nome, NULL::text,
      s.tipo_demanda,
      s.urgencia,
      pr.nome,
      s.data_prevista_atendimento,
      'Abrir atendimento'::text,
      COALESCE(s.data_prevista_atendimento, s.created_at),
      true,
      '/app/atendimentos?demanda=' || s.id::text,
      'demandas'
    FROM public.portal_solicitacoes s
    LEFT JOIN public.clientes c  ON c.id = s.cliente_id
    LEFT JOIN public.fazendas f  ON f.id = s.fazenda_id
    LEFT JOIN public.talhoes  t  ON t.id = s.talhao_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.user_id = s.consultor_atribuido
    WHERE s.status NOT IN ('concluida','cancelada')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.registros_consultor r WHERE r.solicitacao_id = s.id AND public.can_view_technical_visit(v_uid,r.id))
      AND public.can_user_access_solicitacao(s.id)
      AND (v_is_admin OR (s.consultor_atribuido = v_uid AND public.technical_client_link(v_uid,s.cliente_id,ARRAY['execute','manage'])))
      AND (v_q IS NULL OR (
        COALESCE(s.numero_solicitacao,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
        OR COALESCE(s.descricao,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
        OR COALESCE(c.nome,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
        OR COALESCE(f.nome,'') ILIKE '%'||v_q||'%'
      ))
  ),
  filtrado AS (
    SELECT * FROM base b
     WHERE v_aba = 'todos'
        OR (v_aba = 'ocorrencias' AND b.kind = 'visita' AND b.origem = 'ocorrencia_campo')
        OR (v_aba <> 'ocorrencias' AND v_aba = b.bucket)
  ),
  contagem AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM filtrado),
  pagina AS (
    SELECT * FROM filtrado ORDER BY data_ref DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT v_size OFFSET (v_page-1)*v_size
  )
  SELECT (SELECT n FROM contagem),
         COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.data_ref DESC NULLS LAST) FROM pagina p), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_total, v_items;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'items', v_items,
    'total', v_total,
    'page', v_page,
    'page_size', v_size,
    'has_more', (v_page * v_size) < v_total
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_visit_immutability()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Technical content is frozen for every nature and actor after submission.
  -- Official RPCs may change status; version, timestamp and PDF processing are metadata.
  IF OLD.status::text NOT IN ('rascunho', 'em_andamento') AND
    (to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY['status','version','updated_at','pdf_status']::text[])
      IS DISTINCT FROM
    (to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY['status','version','updated_at','pdf_status']::text[])
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'technical_record_content_locked'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514',
      HINT = 'Use the authorized adjustment workflow before editing technical content.';
  END IF;
  NEW.version := COALESCE(OLD.version, 1) + 1;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_mark_financial_overdue()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid := platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_org IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()),false) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'FINANCIAL_SCOPE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 UPDATE public.accounts_receivable_installments i SET status='OVERDUE'
 WHERE i.organization_id=v_org AND i.status='OPEN' AND i.due_date<(pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable p WHERE p.id=i.receivable_id AND p.organization_id=v_org);
 UPDATE public.accounts_payable_installments i SET status='OVERDUE'
 WHERE i.organization_id=v_org AND i.status='OPEN' AND i.due_date<(pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable p WHERE p.id=i.payable_id AND p.organization_id=v_org);
 UPDATE public.accounts_receivable p SET status='OVERDUE'
 WHERE p.organization_id=v_org AND p.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL')
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=p.id AND i.organization_id=v_org AND i.status='OVERDUE');
 UPDATE public.accounts_payable p SET status='OVERDUE'
 WHERE p.organization_id=v_org AND p.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL')
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable_installments i WHERE i.payable_id=p.id AND i.organization_id=v_org AND i.status='OVERDUE');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_aging(_type text DEFAULT 'RECEIVABLE'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(bucket text, total numeric, qtd integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF _type = 'PAYABLE' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT CASE WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 0 THEN 'A vencer'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 30 THEN '1-30'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 60 THEN '31-60'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 90 THEN '61-90'
                ELSE '90+' END,
           SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))::numeric,
           COUNT(*)::int
    FROM accounts_payable_installments
    WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT CASE WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 0 THEN 'A vencer'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 30 THEN '1-30'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 60 THEN '31-60'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 90 THEN '61-90'
                ELSE '90+' END,
           SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))::numeric,
           COUNT(*)::int
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments
    WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.saas_feature_override_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'saas_history_immutable: exceções não podem ser apagadas' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND (
    NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
    OR NEW.feature_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.feature_id
    OR NEW.mode IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.mode
    OR NEW.limit_value IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.limit_value
    OR NEW.starts_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.starts_at
    OR NEW.ends_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ends_at
    OR NEW.reason IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reason
    OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by
    OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
    OR OLD.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.ended_at IS NULL
    OR NEW.ended_by IS NULL
    OR NULLIF(btrim(NEW.end_reason), '') IS NULL
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'saas_history_immutable: somente encerramento auditado é permitido' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_fiscal_invoice_sync_normalized_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_norm text;
BEGIN
  v_norm := upper(btrim(coalesce(NEW.status, '')));
  v_norm := CASE v_norm
    WHEN 'PENDING'   THEN 'DRAFT'
    WHEN 'RASCUNHO'  THEN 'DRAFT'
    WHEN 'ISSUED'    THEN 'AUTHORIZED'   -- H7-003: emitida == autorizada
    WHEN 'EMITIDA'   THEN 'AUTHORIZED'
    WHEN 'AUTORIZADA' THEN 'AUTHORIZED'
    WHEN 'CANCELADA' THEN 'CANCELED'
    WHEN 'REJEITADA' THEN 'REJECTED'
    WHEN 'ERRO'      THEN 'ERROR'
    ELSE v_norm
  END;
  IF v_norm NOT IN ('LEGACY_RECORDED','DRAFT','VALIDATING','READY','QUEUED','PROCESSING',
                    'AUTHORIZED','REJECTED','ERROR','CANCEL_REQUESTED','CANCELED','SUBSTITUTED') THEN
    v_norm := COALESCE(NEW.normalized_status, 'DRAFT');
  END IF;
  NEW.normalized_status := v_norm;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_h7_fiscal_invoice_immutable_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_fiscal_status_is_terminal(OLD.normalized_status) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.invoice_number IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.invoice_number
     OR NEW.series        IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.series
     OR NEW.access_key    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.access_key
     OR NEW.total_amount  IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total_amount
     OR NEW.issue_date    IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.issue_date
     OR NEW.invoice_type  IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.invoice_type
     OR NEW.receivable_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.receivable_id
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'FISCAL_DOCUMENT_LOCKED: documento em estado % nao aceita alteracao economica/fiscal informal.',
      OLD.normalized_status
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  -- Transições de estado permitidas a partir de um estado terminal.
  IF NEW.normalized_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.normalized_status THEN
    IF NOT (OLD.normalized_status = 'AUTHORIZED'
            AND NEW.normalized_status IN ('CANCEL_REQUESTED','CANCELED','SUBSTITUTED')) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'FISCAL_STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID: % -> % nao permitida.',
        OLD.normalized_status, NEW.normalized_status
        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
functions.name: tg_h7_fiscal_invoice_immutable_v1

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_event_sefaz_reconcile_v1(_event_id uuid, _transmission_id uuid, _c_stat text, _x_motivo text, _n_prot text DEFAULT NULL::text, _dh_registro timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_state record; v_type text; v_key text; v_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_state FROM public.v_fiscal_sefaz_event_state WHERE event_id = _event_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_EVENT_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
  IF coalesce(_c_stat, '') = '' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_EVENT_CSTAT_REQUIRED'; END IF;

  v_type := CASE WHEN _c_stat IN ('135','136','155')
                 THEN 'SEFAZ_EVENT_REGISTERED' ELSE 'SEFAZ_EVENT_REJECTED' END;
  v_key := 'RECONCILE:' || _event_id::text || ':' || _c_stat || ':' || coalesce(_n_prot, '-');

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.fiscal_events
     WHERE related_event_id = _event_id AND idempotency_key = v_key) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('eventId', _event_id, 'state',
      CASE WHEN v_type = 'SEFAZ_EVENT_REGISTERED' THEN 'REGISTERED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END,
      'idempotentReplay', true);
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.fiscal_events (
    fiscal_invoice_id, event_type, event_source, related_event_id,
    sefaz_event_code, sefaz_seq_evento, sefaz_access_key,
    sefaz_c_stat, sefaz_n_prot, sefaz_transmission_id,
    idempotency_key, payload_fingerprint, response_snapshot, notes)
  VALUES (
    v_state.fiscal_invoice_id, v_type, 'SEFAZ_HOMOLOGATION', _event_id,
    v_state.sefaz_event_code, v_state.sefaz_seq_evento, v_state.sefaz_access_key,
    _c_stat, _n_prot, _transmission_id,
    v_key, encode(extensions.digest(v_key, 'sha256'), 'hex'),
    jsonb_build_object('cStat', _c_stat, 'xMotivo', left(coalesce(_x_motivo, ''), 200),
                       'nProt', _n_prot, 'dhRegistro', _dh_registro,
                       'environmentCode', '2'),
    left(coalesce(_x_motivo, ''), 2000))
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('eventId', _event_id, 'reconciliationEventId', v_id,
    'state', CASE WHEN v_type = 'SEFAZ_EVENT_REGISTERED' THEN 'REGISTERED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END,
    'idempotentReplay', false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_sefaz_transmission_status_v1(_invoice_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_items jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();
  IF _invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM public.h15_require_invoice(_invoice_id); END IF;

  IF NOT public.fn_fiscal_can_read_internal(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_FORBIDDEN';
  END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x->>'createdAt' DESC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_items
  FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'transmissionId', t.id, 'service', t.service, 'state', t.state,
      'outcome', t.outcome,
      'invoiceId', t.fiscal_invoice_id, 'xmlRunId', t.xml_run_id,
      'eventId', t.fiscal_event_id,
      'environmentCode', t.environment_code, 'endpointHost', t.endpoint_host,
      'cStat', t.c_stat, 'xMotivo', t.x_motivo, 'chNFe', t.ch_nfe,
      'nProt', t.n_prot, 'nRec', t.n_rec, 'dhRecbto', t.dh_recbto,
      'errorCode', t.error_code, 'attempt', t.attempt,
      'correlationId', t.correlation_id,
      'createdAt', t.created_at, 'completedAt', t.completed_at) AS x
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_sefaz_transmissions WHERE public.h15_invoice_access(fiscal_invoice_id)) t
    WHERE (_invoice_id IS NULL OR t.fiscal_invoice_id = _invoice_id)
    ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 50
  ) s;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ceiling', 'HOMOLOGATION', 'environmentCode', '2',
                            'items', v_items);
END $function$
