CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_visita_workspace(p_registro_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_reg public.registros_consultor%ROWTYPE;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_is_admin boolean;
  v_is_manager boolean;
  v_can_manage boolean;
  v_editable boolean;
  v_is_participant boolean;
  v_internal boolean;          -- audiência interna (admin/gestor/participante/responsável)
  v_released boolean;          -- conteúdo formalmente liberado ao produtor
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- H9-D-L5: autorizacao ANTES de qualquer leitura; ausencia e falta de
  -- permissao retornam o MESMO erro generico (sem oraculo de existencia).
  IF NOT public.can_view_technical_visit(v_uid, p_registro_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_visita' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_reg FROM public.registros_consultor WHERE id = p_registro_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_visita' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_is_admin       := public.has_role(v_uid, 'administrador');
  v_is_manager     := public.is_visit_org_manager(v_uid, p_registro_id);
  v_can_manage     := public.can_manage_technical_visit(v_uid, p_registro_id);
  v_editable       := public.is_technical_visit_editable_status(v_reg.status::text);
  v_is_participant := public.is_active_visit_participant(v_uid, p_registro_id);

  v_internal := v_is_admin OR v_is_manager OR v_is_participant
                OR public.is_visit_responsible(v_uid, p_registro_id)
                OR v_can_manage;
  v_released := v_reg.status::text IN ('aprovado', 'convertido_os');

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'audience', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN 'interna' ELSE 'produtor' END,
    'registro', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_reg.id,
      'codigo_visita', v_reg.codigo_visita,
      'status', v_reg.status,
      'version', v_reg.version,
      'cliente_id', v_reg.cliente_id,
      'fazenda_id', v_reg.fazenda_id,
      'talhao_id', v_reg.talhao_id,
      'cultura_id', v_reg.cultura_id,
      'solicitacao_id', v_reg.solicitacao_id,
      'registro_origem_id', v_reg.registro_origem_id,
      'data_vistoria', v_reg.data_vistoria,
      'tipo_visita', v_reg.tipo_visita,
      'natureza_registro', v_reg.natureza_registro,
      'objetivo_visita', v_reg.objetivo_visita,
      'safra', v_reg.safra,
      'fase_fenologica', v_reg.fase_fenologica,
      'area_hectares', v_reg.area_hectares,
      'tipo_demanda', v_reg.tipo_demanda,
      'problema_principal', v_reg.problema_principal,
      'problema_secundario', v_reg.problema_secundario,
      'categoria_problema', v_reg.categoria_problema,
      'nivel_pressao', v_reg.nivel_pressao,
      'percentual_area_afetada', v_reg.percentual_area_afetada,
      'localizacao_na_area', v_reg.localizacao_na_area,
      'condicoes_climaticas_observadas', v_reg.condicoes_climaticas_observadas,
      'urgencia', v_reg.urgencia,
      'risco_produtivo', v_reg.risco_produtivo,
      'necessidade_intervencao', v_reg.necessidade_intervencao,
      'acao_realizada', v_reg.acao_realizada,
      'proxima_acao_recomendada', v_reg.proxima_acao_recomendada,
      'data_proxima_visita', v_reg.data_proxima_visita,
      'pdf_status', v_reg.pdf_status,
      -- campos internos somente para audiência interna
      'observacoes_tecnicas', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.observacoes_tecnicas END,
      'historico_resumido',   CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.historico_resumido END,
      'hora_inicio',          CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.hora_inicio END,
      'hora_fim',             CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.hora_fim END,
      'client_uuid',          CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.client_uuid END,
      'consultor_responsavel', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.consultor_responsavel END,
      'created_by',           CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.created_by END,
      'finalized_at',         CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.finalized_at END,
      'finalized_by',         CASE WHEN v_internal THEN v_reg.finalized_by END,
      'created_at',           v_reg.created_at,
      'updated_at',           v_reg.updated_at
    ),
    'version', v_reg.version,
    'status', v_reg.status,
    'permissions', jsonb_build_object(
      'can_view', true,
      'can_manage', v_can_manage,
      'can_edit', v_can_manage AND v_editable,
      'can_checkin', public.can_checkin_technical_visit(v_uid, p_registro_id),
      'can_checkout', public.can_checkout_technical_visit(v_uid, p_registro_id),
      'can_approve', (v_is_admin OR v_is_manager),
      'can_manage_team', (v_is_admin OR v_is_manager OR public.is_visit_responsible(v_uid, p_registro_id)),
      'can_convert_os', (v_can_manage IS TRUE AND v_reg.status::text = 'aprovado'),
      'can_view_internal', v_internal,
      'is_editable_status', v_editable,
      'is_admin', v_is_admin,
      'is_manager', v_is_manager,
      'is_participant', v_is_participant
    ),
    'cliente', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'nome', c.nome, 'codigo_cliente', c.codigo_cliente)
                  FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id = v_reg.cliente_id),
    'fazenda', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', f.id, 'nome', f.nome, 'municipio', f.municipio, 'estado', f.estado)
                  FROM public.fazendas f WHERE f.id = v_reg.fazenda_id),
    'talhao',  (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', t.id, 'nome', t.nome, 'area_hectares', t.area_hectares)
                  FROM public.talhoes t WHERE t.id = v_reg.talhao_id),
    'cultura', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id', cu.id, 'nome', cu.nome)
                  FROM public.culturas cu WHERE cu.id = v_reg.cultura_id),
    'solicitacao', (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                        'id', s.id, 'numero_solicitacao', s.numero_solicitacao,
                        'status', s.status, 'tipo_demanda', s.tipo_demanda,
                        'urgencia', s.urgencia,
                        'data_prevista_atendimento', s.data_prevista_atendimento,
                        'descricao', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN s.descricao END)
                      FROM public.portal_solicitacoes s WHERE s.id = v_reg.solicitacao_id),

    'equipe', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', a.id, 'user_id', a.user_id, 'role', a.role,
                 'is_active', a.is_active, 'assigned_at', a.assigned_at,
                 'removed_at', a.removed_at)
               ORDER BY a.assigned_at)
          FROM public.technical_visit_assignments a
         WHERE a.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,

    'checkins', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', ck.id, 'tipo_checkin', ck.tipo_checkin, 'status', ck.status,
                 'data_hora_checkin', ck.data_hora_checkin,
                 'latitude', ck.latitude, 'longitude', ck.longitude,
                 'precisao_gps', ck.precisao_gps,
                 'justificativa_sem_gps', ck.justificativa_sem_gps,
                 'observacoes', ck.observacoes,
                 'has_foto', (ck.foto_path IS NOT NULL OR ck.foto_url IS NOT NULL),
                 'client_uuid', ck.client_uuid)
               ORDER BY ck.created_at)
          FROM public.visitas_checkin ck
         WHERE ck.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,

    'campo', (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                  'id', vc.id, 'area_avaliada_ha', vc.area_avaliada_ha,
                  'fase_fenologica', vc.fase_fenologica,
                  'estande_plantas_ha', vc.estande_plantas_ha,
                  'uniformidade', vc.uniformidade,
                  'observacoes_campo', vc.observacoes_campo,
                  'dados_extras', vc.dados_extras,
                  'versao', vc.versao, 'updated_at', vc.updated_at)
                FROM public.visitas_campo vc WHERE vc.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id),

    'diagnosticos', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', d.id, 'problema', d.problema, 'categoria', d.categoria,
                 'severidade', d.severidade, 'incidencia', d.incidencia,
                 'descricao', d.descricao, 'localizacao', d.localizacao,
                 'urgencia', d.urgencia, 'risco', d.risco, 'intervencao', d.intervencao,
                 'versao', d.versao, 'created_at', d.created_at)
               ORDER BY d.created_at)
          FROM public.visita_diagnosticos d
         WHERE d.registro_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb),

    'evidencias', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', ar.id, 'tipo_arquivo', ar.tipo_arquivo,
                 'categoria_arquivo', ar.categoria_arquivo,
                 'tipo_midia', ar.tipo_midia, 'legenda', ar.legenda,
                 'foto_principal', ar.foto_principal, 'ponto_area', ar.ponto_area,
                 'nome_arquivo', ar.nome_arquivo,
                 'duracao_segundos', ar.duracao_segundos,
                 'uploaded_at', ar.uploaded_at,
                 'has_arquivo', (ar.arquivo_path IS NOT NULL OR ar.arquivo_url IS NOT NULL))
               ORDER BY ar.uploaded_at)
          FROM public.registros_consultor_arquivos ar
         WHERE ar.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb),

    'recomendacoes', CASE WHEN v_internal OR v_released THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', r.id, 'objetivo_recomendacao', r.objetivo_recomendacao,
                 'estrategia_manejo', r.estrategia_manejo,
                 'recomendacao_tecnica', r.recomendacao_tecnica,
                 'produto_biologico_sugerido_id', r.produto_biologico_sugerido_id,
                 'microrganismo_id', r.microrganismo_id,
                 'dose_recomendada_valor', r.dose_recomendada_valor,
                 'dose_recomendada_unidade', r.dose_recomendada_unidade,
                 'volume_calda', r.volume_calda,
                 'volume_total_recomendado', r.volume_total_recomendado,
                 'modo_aplicacao', r.modo_aplicacao,
                 'momento_aplicacao', r.momento_aplicacao,
                 'numero_aplicacoes', r.numero_aplicacoes,
                 'intervalo_aplicacoes', r.intervalo_aplicacoes,
                 'compatibilidade_observacoes', r.compatibilidade_observacoes,
                 'cuidados_operacionais', r.cuidados_operacionais,
                 'observacoes_finais', r.observacoes_finais,
                 'encaminhar_para_os', r.encaminhar_para_os,
                 'versao', r.versao, 'created_at', r.created_at)
               ORDER BY r.created_at)
          FROM public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes r
         WHERE r.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,

    'comentarios', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', cm.id, 'recomendacao_id', cm.recomendacao_id,
                 'autor_tipo', cm.autor_tipo, 'autor_nome', cm.autor_nome,
                 'mensagem', cm.mensagem, 'created_at', cm.created_at)
               ORDER BY cm.created_at)
          FROM public.recomendacao_comentarios cm
          JOIN public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes r2 ON r2.id = cm.recomendacao_id
         WHERE r2.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,

    'aprovacoes', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', ap.id, 'status_aprovacao', ap.status_aprovacao,
                 'comentario_gestor', ap.comentario_gestor,
                 'aprovado_por_role', ap.aprovado_por_role,
                 'data_aprovacao', ap.data_aprovacao,
                 'override', ap.override, 'created_at', ap.created_at)
               ORDER BY ap.created_at)
          FROM public.aprovacoes_tecnicas ap
         WHERE ap.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,

    'timeline', CASE WHEN v_internal THEN COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', l.id, 'acao', l.acao, 'descricao', l.descricao,
                 'data_hora', l.data_hora, 'created_at', l.created_at,
                 'metadata', l.metadata)
               ORDER BY l.created_at)
          FROM public.visitas_logs l
         WHERE l.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,

    'monitoramento', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', m.id, 'tipo', m.tipo,
                 'data_referencia', m.data_referencia, 'enviado_em', m.enviado_em)
               ORDER BY m.enviado_em)
          FROM public.monitoramento_avisos m
         WHERE m.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb),

    'ordens_servico', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', os.id, 'numero_os', os.numero_os, 'status', os.status,
                 -- contrato JSON preservado por alias: coluna real e os.data_recomendada
                 'data_prevista', os.data_recomendada, 'created_at', os.created_at)
               ORDER BY os.created_at)
          FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm os
         WHERE os.registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb),

    'retornos', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                 'id', rr.id, 'status', rr.status,
                 'data_vistoria', rr.data_vistoria, 'tipo_visita', rr.tipo_visita))
          FROM public.registros_consultor rr
         WHERE rr.registro_origem_id = p_registro_id), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO v_result;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(module_key text, feature_key text, limit_value numeric, config jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH actor AS (
    SELECT p.organization_id
    FROM public.profiles p
    JOIN public.organizations org
      ON org.id = p.organization_id
     AND org.ativo IS TRUE
    WHERE p.user_id = _uid
      AND p.ativo IS TRUE
      AND p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY p.created_at, p.organization_id
    LIMIT 1
  ), current_subscription AS (
    SELECT s.organization_id, s.plan_version_id
    FROM public.organization_subscriptions s
    JOIN actor a ON a.organization_id = s.organization_id
    JOIN public.saas_plan_versions v
      ON v.id = s.plan_version_id
     AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED'
     AND v.effective_from <= now()
     AND (v.effective_to IS NULL OR v.effective_to > now())
    WHERE s.plan_version_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        s.status = 'ACTIVE'
        OR (s.status = 'TRIAL' AND s.trial_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND s.trial_ends_at > now())
      )
      AND (s.cancel_at IS NULL OR s.cancel_at > now())
    ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ), candidates AS (
    SELECT f.id AS feature_id, f.module_id, f.key AS feature_key,
           vf.enabled AS base_enabled, vf.limit_value AS base_limit, vf.config AS base_config
    FROM current_subscription s
    JOIN public.saas_plan_version_features vf ON vf.plan_version_id = s.plan_version_id
    JOIN public.saas_features f ON f.id = vf.feature_id AND f.active IS TRUE
    UNION
    SELECT f.id, f.module_id, f.key, false, NULL::numeric, NULL::jsonb
    FROM current_subscription s
    JOIN public.organization_feature_overrides o ON o.organization_id = s.organization_id
    JOIN public.saas_features f ON f.id = o.feature_id AND f.active IS TRUE
    WHERE o.ended_at IS NULL
      AND o.starts_at <= now()
      AND (o.ends_at IS NULL OR o.ends_at > now())
  ), effective AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.feature_id)
      c.feature_id, c.module_id, c.feature_key,
      CASE
        WHEN o.mode = 'REVOKE' THEN false
        WHEN o.mode = 'GRANT' THEN true
        ELSE c.base_enabled
      END AS enabled,
      CASE
        WHEN o.mode = 'GRANT' THEN o.limit_value
        WHEN o.mode = 'REVOKE' THEN NULL::numeric
        ELSE c.base_limit
      END AS effective_limit,
      c.base_config AS effective_config
    FROM candidates c
    CROSS JOIN current_subscription s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT x.mode, x.limit_value
      FROM public.organization_feature_overrides x
      WHERE x.organization_id = s.organization_id
        AND x.feature_id = c.feature_id
        AND x.ended_at IS NULL
        AND x.starts_at <= now()
        AND (x.ends_at IS NULL OR x.ends_at > now())
      ORDER BY x.created_at DESC, x.id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) o ON true
    ORDER BY c.feature_id
  )
  SELECT m.key::text, e.feature_key::text, e.effective_limit::numeric, e.effective_config
  FROM effective e
  JOIN public.saas_modules m ON m.id = e.module_id AND m.active IS TRUE
  WHERE e.enabled IS TRUE
  ORDER BY m.key, e.feature_key
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_listar_visitas_tecnicas_v1(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_de date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_ate date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_cliente_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_fazenda_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_page integer := GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page, 1), 1);
  v_size integer := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_page_size, 25), 1), 100);
  v_search text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search, '')), '');
  v_total bigint := 0;
  v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  WITH base AS (
    SELECT r.*
      FROM public.registros_consultor r
     WHERE public.can_view_technical_visit(v_uid, r.id)
       AND (p_status IS NULL OR array_length(p_status, 1) IS NULL OR r.status::text = ANY (p_status))
       AND (p_cliente_id IS NULL OR r.cliente_id = p_cliente_id)
       AND (p_fazenda_id IS NULL OR r.fazenda_id = p_fazenda_id)
       AND (p_de IS NULL OR r.data_vistoria >= p_de)
       AND (p_ate IS NULL OR r.data_vistoria <= p_ate)
       AND (
         v_search IS NULL
         OR r.codigo_visita ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
         OR r.objetivo_visita ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
         OR r.problema_principal ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id = r.cliente_id AND c.nome ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%')
         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.fazendas f WHERE f.id = r.fazenda_id AND f.nome ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%')
       )
  ), counted AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS total FROM base
  ), pagina AS (
    SELECT b.* FROM base b
     ORDER BY b.data_vistoria DESC NULLS LAST, b.created_at DESC
     LIMIT v_size OFFSET (v_page - 1) * v_size
  )
  SELECT (SELECT total FROM counted),
         COALESCE((
           SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
             'id', p.id,
             'codigo_visita', p.codigo_visita,
             'status', p.status,
             'data_vistoria', p.data_vistoria,
             'tipo_visita', p.tipo_visita,
             'objetivo_visita', p.objetivo_visita,
             'problema_principal', p.problema_principal,
             'categoria_problema', p.categoria_problema,
             'nivel_pressao', p.nivel_pressao,
             'urgencia', p.urgencia,
             'risco_produtivo', p.risco_produtivo,
             'necessidade_intervencao', p.necessidade_intervencao,
             'created_at', p.created_at,
             'cliente_id', p.cliente_id,
             'cliente_nome', (SELECT c.nome FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id = p.cliente_id),
             'fazenda_id', p.fazenda_id,
             'fazenda_nome', (SELECT f.nome FROM public.fazendas f WHERE f.id = p.fazenda_id),
             'talhao_nome', (SELECT t.nome FROM public.talhoes t WHERE t.id = p.talhao_id),
             'can_edit', (public.can_manage_technical_visit(v_uid, p.id)
                          AND public.is_technical_visit_editable_status(p.status::text))
           ))
           FROM pagina p
         ), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_total, v_items;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'items', v_items,
    'total', v_total,
    'page', v_page,
    'page_size', v_size,
    'has_more', (v_page * v_size) < v_total
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_microorganism_regulatory_overview()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_regulatory_can_read() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x->>'codigo'),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'microorganism_id', m.id,
      'codigo', m.codigo,
      'nome', m.nome,
      'tipo', m.tipo,
      'ativo', m.ativo,
      'concentracao_label', m.concentracao_label,
      'facts', f.facts,
      'checklist_total', coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_total')::int, 0),
      'checklist_confirmed', coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_confirmed')::int, 0),
      'checklist_pending', coalesce(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(f.facts->'checklist_pending','[]'::jsonb)),0),
      'progress_pct', CASE WHEN coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_total')::int,0) = 0 THEN 0
                           ELSE round(100.0 * (coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_total')::int,0)
                                - jsonb_array_length(coalesce(f.facts->'checklist_pending','[]'::jsonb)))
                                / coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_total')::int,1)) END,
      'dossier_status', coalesce(f.facts->>'status','NONE'),
      'profile_status', r.profile_status,
      'fiscally_ready', coalesce(r.fiscally_ready,false),
      'technical_ready', coalesce(r.minimally_classified,false),
      'regulatory_ready', coalesce(r.regulatory_ready,false),
      'quarantined', coalesce(r.quarantined,false),
      'pendencies', coalesce(r.pendencies,'[]'::jsonb),
      'not_applicable', coalesce(r.not_applicable,'[]'::jsonb)) AS x
    FROM public.microrganismos m
    LEFT JOIN public.v_microorganism_fiscal_readiness r ON r.microorganism_id = m.id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts(m.id) AS facts) f
    WHERE m.ativo
  ) s;
  RETURN v;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_partner_commercial_history(p_partner_id uuid, p_from date DEFAULT ((now())::date - 365), p_to date DEFAULT (now())::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb; top jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (
    public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador')
    OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial')
    OR (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'parceiro_b2b') AND public.get_user_partner_id() = p_partner_id)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) INTO top FROM (
    SELECT poi.produto_nome_snapshot AS produto,
           SUM(poi.quantidade) AS quantidade,
           SUM(poi.subtotal) AS valor
    FROM public.partner_order_items poi
    JOIN public.partner_orders po ON po.id = poi.order_id
    WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
      AND po.created_at::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
    GROUP BY poi.produto_nome_snapshot
    ORDER BY SUM(poi.subtotal) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'qtd_pedidos', COUNT(*),
    'valor_acumulado', COALESCE(SUM(total),0),
    'ticket_medio', COALESCE(AVG(total),0),
    'ultima_compra', MAX(created_at),
    'top_produtos', top
  ) INTO r
  FROM public.partner_orders
  WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND created_at::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to;
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_portal_partner_financial(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(partner_order_id uuid, numero text, receivable_id uuid, total numeric, vencimento date, financial_status text, payment_method text, ar_status text, installments jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_is_staff boolean := (has_role(v_uid, 'administrador'::app_role) OR has_role(v_uid, 'gestor_comercial'::app_role));
  v_filter_partner uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_partner_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT v_is_staff THEN
      -- Parceiro só pode ver o próprio; ignora tentativa de simular
      v_filter_partner := NULL;
    ELSE
      v_filter_partner := p_partner_id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    po.id, po.numero, ar.id, po.total, po.payment_due_date, po.financial_status, po.payment_method, ar.status,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'numero', i.installment_number, 'vencimento', i.due_date,
        'valor', i.original_amount, 'recebido', i.received_amount, 'status', i.status
      ) ORDER BY i.installment_number)
      FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id = ar.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  JOIN public.partner_order_financial_links l ON l.partner_order_id = po.id
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = l.receivable_id
  WHERE
    (
      v_filter_partner IS NOT NULL AND po.partner_id = v_filter_partner
    )
    OR (
      v_filter_partner IS NULL AND po.partner_id IN (SELECT partner_id FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id = v_uid)
    )
  ORDER BY po.created_at DESC;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_actor_scope(_uid uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(profile_ok boolean, org_partner uuid, user_partner uuid, user_partner_count integer, partner_valid boolean, has_catalog boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH pr AS (
    SELECT o.partner_account_id
      FROM public.profiles p JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = p.organization_id
     WHERE p.user_id = _uid AND p.ativo = true AND o.ativo = true AND o.status = 'ativa'
     LIMIT 1
  ), pu AS (
    SELECT count(*)::int c, min(partner_id::text)::uuid pid
      FROM public.partner_users
     WHERE user_id = _uid AND revoked_at IS NULL
  ), valid AS (
    -- Caminho fornecedor: vínculo só resolve o parceiro com a cadeia completa
    -- perfil→organização→tenant→proprietário comprovada no servidor.
    SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT c FROM pu) = 1
                 AND public.is_valid_b2b_partner_user(_uid, (SELECT pid FROM pu))
                 AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1
                     FROM public.partner_users puv
                     JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = puv.partner_id
                     JOIN public.organizations owner ON owner.id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                     JOIN public.profiles pf ON pf.user_id = puv.user_id
                     JOIN public.organizations porg ON porg.id = pf.organization_id
                    WHERE puv.user_id = _uid
                      AND puv.partner_id = (SELECT pid FROM pu)
                      AND puv.revoked_at IS NULL
                      AND (puv.valid_from IS NULL OR puv.valid_from <= now())
                      AND pf.ativo = true
                      AND porg.ativo = true AND porg.status = 'ativa'
                      AND pf.organization_id = puv.tenant_id
                      AND puv.tenant_id = pa.commercial_owner_organization_id
                      AND pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
                      AND owner.ativo = true AND owner.status = 'ativa'
                 )
              THEN (SELECT pid FROM pu) END AS pid
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr),
         -- Organização com parceiro explícito prevalece; sem ela, o vínculo autorizado
         -- validado resolve o parceiro. Se ambos existirem e divergirem, org_partner
         -- permanece o da organização e os consumidores negam por mismatch.
         COALESCE((SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr), (SELECT pid FROM valid)),
         (SELECT pid FROM valid),
         (SELECT c FROM pu),
         CASE WHEN (SELECT partner_account_id FROM pr) IS NOT NULL
              THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pr JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pr.partner_account_id
                            WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL)
              ELSE (SELECT pid FROM valid) IS NOT NULL END,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.entitlements_for_user(_uid) e WHERE e.feature_key = 'catalogo_precos');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_regulatory_checklist_set(p_dossier_id uuid, p_item_key text, p_state text, p_justification text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_evidence_document_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_status text; v_row public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_regulatory_can_prepare() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_state = 'NOT_APPLICABLE' AND nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_justification,'')),'') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT status INTO v_status FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers
   WHERE id = p_dossier_id AND deleted_at IS NULL;
  IF v_status IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_DOSSIER_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF v_status NOT IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_DOSSIER_NOT_EDITABLE' USING ERRCODE='55006';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.microorganism_regulatory_checklist AS c
    (dossier_id, item_key, state, justification, evidence_document_id, decided_by, decided_at)
  VALUES (p_dossier_id, p_item_key, p_state, p_justification, p_evidence_document_id,
          CASE WHEN p_state='PENDING' THEN NULL ELSE auth.uid() END,
          CASE WHEN p_state='PENDING' THEN NULL ELSE now() END)
  ON CONFLICT (dossier_id, item_key) DO UPDATE SET
    state = EXCLUDED.state,
    justification = EXCLUDED.justification,
    evidence_document_id = EXCLUDED.evidence_document_id,
    decided_by = EXCLUDED.decided_by,
    decided_at = EXCLUDED.decided_at
  RETURNING * INTO v_row;

  -- Mudança de checklist invalida aprovações já concedidas
  UPDATE public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers SET
    technical_review_status = CASE WHEN technical_review_status='APPROVED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE technical_review_status END,
    regulatory_review_status = CASE WHEN regulatory_review_status='APPROVED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE regulatory_review_status END,
    fiscal_review_status = CASE WHEN fiscal_review_status='APPROVED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE fiscal_review_status END,
    updated_by = auth.uid()
  WHERE id = p_dossier_id;

  RETURN to_jsonb(v_row);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_regulatory_dossier_update_draft(p_dossier_id uuid, p_patch jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_status text; v_row public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.fn_regulatory_can_prepare() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT status INTO v_status FROM public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers
   WHERE id = p_dossier_id AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE;
  IF v_status IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_DOSSIER_NOT_FOUND' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  IF v_status NOT IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_REVIEW') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'REGULATORY_DOSSIER_NOT_EDITABLE' USING ERRCODE='55006';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.microorganism_regulatory_dossiers d SET
    strain_code = coalesce(p_patch->>'strain_code', d.strain_code),
    strain_name = coalesce(p_patch->>'strain_name', d.strain_name),
    regulatory_category = coalesce(p_patch->>'regulatory_category', d.regulatory_category),
    formulation = coalesce(p_patch->>'formulation', d.formulation),
    label_guarantee = coalesce(p_patch->>'label_guarantee', d.label_guarantee),
    guarantee_unit = coalesce(p_patch->>'guarantee_unit', d.guarantee_unit),
    mapa_registration_number = coalesce(p_patch->>'mapa_registration_number', d.mapa_registration_number),
    mapa_holder = coalesce(p_patch->>'mapa_holder', d.mapa_holder),
    mapa_manufacturer = coalesce(p_patch->>'mapa_manufacturer', d.mapa_manufacturer),
    mapa_status = coalesce(p_patch->>'mapa_status', d.mapa_status),
    mapa_valid_until = coalesce((p_patch->>'mapa_valid_until')::date, d.mapa_valid_until),
    mapa_not_applicable_reason = coalesce(p_patch->>'mapa_not_applicable_reason', d.mapa_not_applicable_reason),
    effective_from = coalesce((p_patch->>'effective_from')::date, d.effective_from),
    effective_to = coalesce((p_patch->>'effective_to')::date, d.effective_to),
    -- Qualquer edição de conteúdo invalida aprovações já dadas
    technical_review_status = CASE WHEN d.technical_review_status='APPROVED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE d.technical_review_status END,
    regulatory_review_status = CASE WHEN d.regulatory_review_status='APPROVED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE d.regulatory_review_status END,
    fiscal_review_status = CASE WHEN d.fiscal_review_status='APPROVED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE d.fiscal_review_status END,
    updated_by = auth.uid()
  WHERE d.id = p_dossier_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_row;

  RETURN to_jsonb(v_row);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_upsert_diagnostico_visita(p_registro_id uuid, p_client_uuid uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_expected_versao integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_existing public.visita_diagnosticos;
  v_new public.visita_diagnosticos;
  v_registro_version integer;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- H9-D-L6: autorizacao de escopo ANTES de qualquer leitura da visita.
  -- Inexistente e alheio (editavel ou nao) retornam o MESMO erro.
  IF NOT public._visita_scope_ok(v_uid, p_registro_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_visita' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public._assert_visita_editavel(p_registro_id);
  IF NOT public.can_manage_technical_visit(v_uid, p_registro_id)
     AND NOT public.is_active_visit_participant(v_uid, p_registro_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_visita' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF p_client_uuid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'client_uuid_obrigatorio' USING ERRCODE = '22004';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_existing
    FROM public.visita_diagnosticos
   WHERE registro_id = p_registro_id
     AND client_uuid = p_client_uuid
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_existing.id IS NOT NULL
     AND COALESCE(p_expected_versao, -1) < v_existing.versao THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'version_conflict' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  IF v_existing.id IS NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.visita_diagnosticos (
      registro_id, client_uuid, categoria, problema, descricao, severidade,
      incidencia, urgencia, risco, intervencao, localizacao, versao, created_by
    ) VALUES (
      p_registro_id, p_client_uuid,
      NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'categoria', p_payload->>'categoria_problema'),''), NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'problema', p_payload->>'problema_principal'),''),
      NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'descricao', p_payload->>'observacoes_tecnicas'),''), NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'severidade', p_payload->>'nivel_pressao'),''),
      NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'incidencia', p_payload->>'percentual_area_afetada'),'')::numeric,
      NULLIF(p_payload->>'urgencia',''), NULLIF(p_payload->>'risco',''),
      NULLIF(p_payload->>'intervencao',''), NULLIF(p_payload->>'localizacao',''),
      GREATEST(1, COALESCE(p_expected_versao, 1)), v_uid
    ) RETURNING * INTO v_new;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.visita_diagnosticos SET
      categoria = NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'categoria', p_payload->>'categoria_problema'),''),
      problema = NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'problema', p_payload->>'problema_principal'),''),
      descricao = NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'descricao', p_payload->>'observacoes_tecnicas'),''),
      severidade = NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'severidade', p_payload->>'nivel_pressao'),''),
      incidencia = NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'incidencia', p_payload->>'percentual_area_afetada'),'')::numeric,
      urgencia = NULLIF(p_payload->>'urgencia',''),
      risco = NULLIF(p_payload->>'risco',''),
      intervencao = NULLIF(p_payload->>'intervencao',''),
      localizacao = NULLIF(p_payload->>'localizacao',''),
      versao = v_existing.versao + 1,
      updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_existing.id
    RETURNING * INTO v_new;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.registros_consultor
     SET problema_principal = COALESCE(NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'problema_principal', p_payload->>'problema'),''), problema_principal),
         categoria_problema = COALESCE(NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'categoria_problema', p_payload->>'categoria'),'')::public.categoria_problema_consultor, categoria_problema),
         nivel_pressao = COALESCE(NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'nivel_pressao', p_payload->>'severidade'),'')::public.nivel_pressao, nivel_pressao),
         percentual_area_afetada = COALESCE(NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'percentual_area_afetada', p_payload->>'incidencia'),'')::numeric, percentual_area_afetada),
         observacoes_tecnicas = COALESCE(NULLIF(COALESCE(p_payload->>'observacoes_tecnicas', p_payload->>'descricao'),''), observacoes_tecnicas),
         urgencia = COALESCE(NULLIF(p_payload->>'urgencia','')::public.urgencia_consultor, urgencia),
         version = COALESCE(version,1) + 1,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_registro_id
   RETURNING version INTO v_registro_version;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_new.id,
    'versao', v_new.versao,
    'registro_version', v_registro_version,
    'client_uuid', v_new.client_uuid
  );
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_upsert_recomendacao_visita(p_registro_id uuid, p_client_uuid uuid, p_payload jsonb, p_expected_versao integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_existing public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes;
  v_new public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes;
  v_ok boolean;
  v_lock uuid;
  v_con text;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;

  v_ok := COALESCE(public.can_manage_technical_visit(v_uid, p_registro_id), false)
       OR COALESCE(public.is_active_visit_participant(v_uid, p_registro_id), false);
  IF v_ok IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden_visita' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public._assert_visita_editavel(p_registro_id);

  IF p_client_uuid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'client_uuid_obrigatorio' USING ERRCODE = '22004'; END IF;

  -- Serializa gravacoes concorrentes: FOR UPDATE na recomendacao nao bloqueia
  -- a ausencia de linha, entao bloqueamos a visita pai (apos autorizacao).
  SELECT id INTO v_lock
    FROM public.registros_consultor
   WHERE id = p_registro_id
   FOR UPDATE;
  IF v_lock IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'registro_nao_encontrado' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_existing
    FROM public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes
   WHERE registro_consultor_id = p_registro_id
     AND client_uuid = p_client_uuid
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_existing.id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF p_expected_versao IS NULL OR p_expected_versao <> v_existing.versao THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'version_conflict' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF COALESCE(p_expected_versao, 1) <> 1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'version_conflict' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_existing.id IS NULL THEN
    BEGIN
      INSERT INTO public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes (
        registro_consultor_id, client_uuid, recomendacao_tecnica,
        objetivo_recomendacao, estrategia_manejo,
        microrganismo_id, produto_biologico_sugerido_id,
        dose_recomendada_valor, dose_recomendada_unidade,
        volume_calda, volume_total_recomendado,
        numero_aplicacoes, intervalo_aplicacoes,
        modo_aplicacao, momento_aplicacao,
        cuidados_operacionais, compatibilidade_observacoes,
        observacoes_finais, encaminhar_para_os,
        versao, created_by
      ) VALUES (
        p_registro_id, p_client_uuid,
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'recomendacao_tecnica',''),
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'objetivo_recomendacao','')::objetivo_recomendacao,
        NULLIF(btrim(p_payload->>'estrategia_manejo'),'')::estrategia_manejo,
        NULLIF((p_payload->>'microrganismo_id'),'')::uuid,
        NULLIF((p_payload->>'produto_biologico_sugerido_id'),'')::uuid,
        NULLIF((p_payload->>'dose_recomendada_valor'),'')::numeric,
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'dose_recomendada_unidade',''),
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'volume_calda',''),
        NULLIF((p_payload->>'volume_total_recomendado'),'')::numeric,
        NULLIF((p_payload->>'numero_aplicacoes'),'')::integer,
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'intervalo_aplicacoes',''),
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'modo_aplicacao','')::modo_aplicacao_consultor,
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'momento_aplicacao',''),
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'cuidados_operacionais',''),
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'compatibilidade_observacoes',''),
        NULLIF(p_payload->>'observacoes_finais',''),
        COALESCE((p_payload->>'encaminhar_para_os')::boolean, false),
        1,
        v_uid
      ) RETURNING * INTO v_new;
    EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
      -- Somente a corrida no indice de idempotencia vira version_conflict.
      -- Qualquer outra unique_violation e relancada sem mascaramento.
      GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS v_con = CONSTRAINT_NAME;
      IF v_con = 'uq_rec_registro_client_uuid' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'version_conflict' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
      END IF;
      RAISE;
    END;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes SET
      recomendacao_tecnica = NULLIF(p_payload->>'recomendacao_tecnica',''),
      objetivo_recomendacao = NULLIF(p_payload->>'objetivo_recomendacao','')::objetivo_recomendacao,
      estrategia_manejo = NULLIF(btrim(p_payload->>'estrategia_manejo'),'')::estrategia_manejo,
      microrganismo_id = NULLIF((p_payload->>'microrganismo_id'),'')::uuid,
      produto_biologico_sugerido_id = NULLIF((p_payload->>'produto_biologico_sugerido_id'),'')::uuid,
      dose_recomendada_valor = NULLIF((p_payload->>'dose_recomendada_valor'),'')::numeric,
      dose_recomendada_unidade = NULLIF(p_payload->>'dose_recomendada_unidade',''),
      volume_calda = NULLIF(p_payload->>'volume_calda',''),
      volume_total_recomendado = NULLIF((p_payload->>'volume_total_recomendado'),'')::numeric,
      numero_aplicacoes = NULLIF((p_payload->>'numero_aplicacoes'),'')::integer,
      intervalo_aplicacoes = NULLIF(p_payload->>'intervalo_aplicacoes',''),
      modo_aplicacao = NULLIF(p_payload->>'modo_aplicacao','')::modo_aplicacao_consultor,
      momento_aplicacao = NULLIF(p_payload->>'momento_aplicacao',''),
      cuidados_operacionais = NULLIF(p_payload->>'cuidados_operacionais',''),
      compatibilidade_observacoes = NULLIF(p_payload->>'compatibilidade_observacoes',''),
      observacoes_finais = NULLIF(p_payload->>'observacoes_finais',''),
      encaminhar_para_os = COALESCE((p_payload->>'encaminhar_para_os')::boolean, encaminhar_para_os),
      versao = v_existing.versao + 1,
      updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_existing.id
    RETURNING * INTO v_new;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id', v_new.id, 'versao', v_new.versao, 'client_uuid', v_new.client_uuid);
END;
$function$

SELECT os_id,
    origem_os,

    volume_total_ml,

    titular_tipo,
    titular_nome,
    programacao_id,
    status_programacao,
    data_programada,
    data_inicio_producao,
    lote_id,
    codigo_lote,
    status_lote,
    data_lote,
    cq_id,
    cq_resultado,
    data_cq,
    envase_id,
    data_envase,
    estoque_id,
    data_estoque,
    estoque_reservado_id,
    data_estoque_reservado,
    entrega_id,
    entrega_status,
    data_entrega,
    aplicacao_id,
    data_aplicacao,
    entrega_confirmada,
    aplicacao_bloqueante,
    pendencias_informativas,
    bloqueios,
    pode_finalizar,
        CASE
            WHEN ((status_esteira_oficial = ANY (ARRAY['programada'::text, 'aberta'::text])) AND ((status_os = 'em_producao'::text) OR (status_programacao = 'em_producao'::text))) THEN 'em_producao'::text
            ELSE status_esteira_oficial
        END AS status_esteira_oficial,
    tempo_os_ate_programacao,
    tempo_programacao_ate_lote,
    tempo_lote_ate_cq,
    tempo_cq_ate_envase,
    tempo_envase_ate_entrega,
    tempo_os_ate_entrega,
    atrasado,
        CASE
            WHEN (programacao_id IS NULL) THEN 'Programar Produção'::text
            WHEN (lote_id IS NULL) THEN 'Gerar Lote'::text
            WHEN ((cq_id IS NULL) OR (cq_resultado IS NULL)) THEN 'Realizar CQ'::text
            WHEN (cq_resultado = 'reprovado'::text) THEN 'Tratar reprovação'::text
            WHEN (envase_id IS NULL) THEN 'Registrar Envase'::text
            WHEN (estoque_reservado_id IS NULL) THEN 'Gerar Estoque/Reserva'::text
            WHEN (entrega_id IS NULL) THEN 'Confirmar Entrega'::text
            WHEN (NOT entrega_confirmada) THEN 'Confirmar Entrega'::text
            WHEN (pode_finalizar AND (status_os <> 'finalizada'::text)) THEN 'Finalizar OS'::text
            WHEN (status_os = 'finalizada'::text) THEN 'Concluído'::text
            ELSE 'Verificar Status'::text

relations.name: vw_os_integridade_esteira
relations.view:
WITH base_os AS (
         SELECT o.id AS os_id,
            'manual'::text AS origem_os,
            o.numero_os,
            o.cliente_id,
            o.fazenda_id,
            o.talhao_id,
            (o.status)::text AS status_os,
            o.created_at,
            o.volume_total_ml,
            o.produto_id,
            o.microrganismo_id,
            (o.prioridade)::text AS prioridade,
            o.partner_order_id
           FROM ordens_servico o
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ofa.id AS os_id,
            'onfarm'::text AS origem_os,
            ofa.numero_os,
            ofa.cliente_id,
            ofa.fazenda_id,
            ofa.talhao_id,
            (ofa.status)::text AS status_os,
            ofa.created_at,
            ofa.volume_total_ml,
            ofa.produto_id,
            ofa.microrganismo_id,
            (ofa.prioridade)::text AS prioridade,
            NULL::uuid AS partner_order_id
           FROM ordens_servico_onfarm ofa
        ), esteira_data AS (
         SELECT bos.os_id,
            bos.origem_os,
            bos.numero_os,
            bos.cliente_id,
            bos.fazenda_id,
            bos.talhao_id,
            bos.status_os,
            bos.created_at,
            bos.volume_total_ml,
            bos.produto_id,
            bos.microrganismo_id,
            bos.prioridade,
            ((bos.volume_total_ml)::double precision / (1000.0)::double precision) AS volume_solicitado_l,
            c.nome AS cliente_nome,
            f.nome AS fazenda_nome,
            t.nome AS talhao_nome,
            p.nome AS produto_nome,
            m.nome AS microrganismo_nome,
            pa.id AS partner_id,
            po.numero AS partner_numero,
            COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social) AS partner_nome,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pa.id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'parceiro'::text
                    WHEN (c.id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'cliente'::text
                    ELSE 'desconhecido'::text
                END AS titular_tipo,
                CASE
                    WHEN (pa.id IS NOT NULL) THEN ('B2B · '::text || COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social))
                    WHEN (c.id IS NOT NULL) THEN c.nome
                    ELSE '—'::text
                END AS titular_nome,
            pp.id AS programacao_id,
            (pp.status)::text AS status_programacao,
            pp.data_programada,
            pp.created_at AS data_inicio_producao,
            l.id AS lote_id,
            l.codigo_lote,
            (l.status)::text AS status_lote,
            l.created_at AS data_lote,
            cq.id AS cq_id,
            (cq.resultado)::text AS cq_resultado,
            cq.created_at AS data_cq,
            ev.id AS envase_id,
            ev.created_at AS data_envase,
            ep.id AS estoque_id,
            ep.created_at AS data_estoque,
            epr.id AS estoque_reservado_id,
            epr.reservado_em AS data_estoque_reservado,
            ent_1.id AS entrega_id,
            (ent_1.status)::text AS entrega_status,
            ent_1.created_at AS data_entrega,
            app.id AS aplicacao_id,
            app.created_at AS data_aplicacao
           FROM (((((((((((((((base_os bos
             LEFT JOIN clientes c ON ((bos.cliente_id = c.id)))
             LEFT JOIN fazendas f ON ((bos.fazenda_id = f.id)))
             LEFT JOIN talhoes t ON ((bos.talhao_id = t.id)))
             LEFT JOIN produtos p ON ((bos.produto_id = p.id)))
             LEFT JOIN microrganismos m ON ((bos.microrganismo_id = m.id)))
             LEFT JOIN partner_orders po ON ((po.id = bos.partner_order_id)))
             LEFT JOIN partner_accounts pa ON ((pa.id = po.partner_id)))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pp_1.id,
                    pp_1.status,
                    pp_1.data_programada,
                    pp_1.created_at
                   FROM programacao_producao pp_1
                  WHERE (((bos.origem_os = 'manual'::text) AND (pp_1.ordem_servico_id = bos.os_id)) OR ((bos.origem_os = 'onfarm'::text) AND (pp_1.ordem_servico_onfarm_id = bos.os_id)))
                  ORDER BY pp_1.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) pp ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l_1.id,
                    l_1.codigo_lote,
                    l_1.status,
                    l_1.created_at
                   FROM lotes l_1
                  WHERE (l_1.programacao_id = pp.id)
                  ORDER BY l_1.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) l ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cq_1.id,
                    cq_1.resultado,
                    cq_1.created_at
                   FROM controle_qualidade cq_1
                  WHERE (cq_1.lote_id = l.id)
                  ORDER BY cq_1.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) cq ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ev_1.id,
                    ev_1.created_at
                   FROM envase ev_1
                  WHERE (ev_1.lote_id = l.id)
                  ORDER BY ev_1.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) ev ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ep_1.id,
                    ep_1.created_at
                   FROM estoque_produto ep_1
                  WHERE (ep_1.lote_id = l.id)
                  ORDER BY ep_1.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) ep ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT epr_1.id,
                    epr_1.reservado_em
                   FROM estoque_produto epr_1
                  WHERE ((epr_1.lote_id = l.id) AND ((epr_1.status)::text = 'reservado'::text) AND (epr_1.reservado_para_os_id = bos.os_id))
                  ORDER BY epr_1.reservado_em DESC NULLS LAST, epr_1.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) epr ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ent_2.id,
                    ent_2.status,
                    ent_2.created_at
                   FROM entregas ent_2
                  WHERE (((bos.origem_os = 'manual'::text) AND (ent_2.ordem_servico_id = bos.os_id)) OR ((bos.origem_os = 'onfarm'::text) AND (ent_2.ordem_servico_onfarm_id = bos.os_id)))
                  ORDER BY ent_2.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) ent_1 ON (true))
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT app_1.id,
                    app_1.created_at
                   FROM aplicacoes app_1
                  WHERE (((bos.origem_os = 'manual'::text) AND (app_1.ordem_servico_id = bos.os_id)) OR ((bos.origem_os = 'onfarm'::text) AND (app_1.ordem_servico_onfarm_id = bos.os_id)))
                  ORDER BY app_1.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 1) app ON (true))
        )
 SELECT ed.os_id,
    ed.origem_os,
    ed.numero_os,
    ed.cliente_id,
    ed.fazenda_id,
    ed.talhao_id,
    ed.status_os,
    ed.created_at,
    ed.volume_total_ml,
    ed.produto_id,
    ed.microrganismo_id,
    ed.prioridade,
    ed.volume_solicitado_l,
    ed.cliente_nome,
    ed.fazenda_nome,
    ed.talhao_nome,
    ed.produto_nome,
    ed.microrganismo_nome,
    ed.partner_id,
    ed.partner_numero,
    ed.partner_nome,
    ed.titular_tipo,
    ed.titular_nome,
    ed.programacao_id,
    ed.status_programacao,
    ed.data_programada,
    ed.data_inicio_producao,
    ed.lote_id,
    ed.codigo_lote,
    ed.status_lote,
    ed.data_lote,
    ed.cq_id,
    ed.cq_resultado,
    ed.data_cq,
    ed.envase_id,
    ed.data_envase,
    ed.estoque_id,
    ed.data_estoque,
    ed.estoque_reservado_id,
    ed.data_estoque_reservado,
    ed.entrega_id,
    ed.entrega_status,
    ed.data_entrega,
    ed.aplicacao_id,
    ed.data_aplicacao,
    ((ent.id IS NOT NULL) AND ((ent.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['entregue'::text, 'confirmada'::text]))) AS entrega_confirmada,
    false AS aplicacao_bloqueante,
    ((ARRAY[]::text[] ||
        CASE
            WHEN ((ed.aplicacao_id IS NULL) AND (ent.id IS NOT NULL) AND ((ent.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['entregue'::text, 'confirmada'::text]))) THEN ARRAY['aplicacao_nao_registrada'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN ((ed.data_programada IS NOT NULL) AND (ed.data_programada < CURRENT_DATE) AND (ed.status_os <> ALL (ARRAY['finalizada'::text, 'cancelada'::text]))) THEN ARRAY['programacao_atrasada'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) AS pendencias_informativas,
    ((((((((ARRAY[]::text[] ||
        CASE
            WHEN (ed.programacao_id IS NULL) THEN ARRAY['sem_programacao'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN (ed.lote_id IS NULL) THEN ARRAY['sem_lote'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN ((ed.lote_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ed.cq_resultado IS DISTINCT FROM 'aprovado'::text)) THEN ARRAY['cq_nao_aprovado'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN (ed.envase_id IS NULL) THEN ARRAY['sem_envase'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN (ed.estoque_id IS NULL) THEN ARRAY['sem_entrada_estoque'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN (ed.estoque_reservado_id IS NULL) THEN ARRAY['sem_reserva_para_os'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN (ed.entrega_id IS NULL) THEN ARRAY['sem_entrega'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN ((ed.entrega_id IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT ((ent.id IS NOT NULL) AND ((ent.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['entregue'::text, 'confirmada'::text]))))) THEN ARRAY['entrega_nao_confirmada'::text]
            ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END) AS bloqueios,
    ((ed.estoque_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ent.id IS NOT NULL) AND ((ent.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['entregue'::text, 'confirmada'::text]))) AS pode_finalizar,
        CASE
            WHEN (ed.status_os = 'finalizada'::text) THEN 'finalizada'::text
            WHEN ((ed.entrega_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ed.entrega_status = ANY (ARRAY['entregue'::text, 'confirmada'::text]))) THEN 'entregue'::text
            WHEN (ed.entrega_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'em_entrega'::text
            WHEN (ed.estoque_reservado_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'estoque_reservado'::text
            WHEN (ed.estoque_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'pronto_entrega'::text
            WHEN (ed.envase_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'envase'::text
            WHEN (ed.status_os = ANY (ARRAY['envase'::text, 'em_envase'::text])) THEN 'envase'::text
            WHEN (ed.status_os = 'pronto_entrega'::text) THEN 'pronto_entrega'::text
            WHEN (ed.cq_resultado = 'aprovado'::text) THEN 'cq_aprovado'::text
            WHEN ((ed.status_os = ANY (ARRAY['em_cq'::text, 'aguardando_cq'::text])) OR (ed.status_programacao = 'aguardando_cq'::text) OR (ed.status_lote = 'aguardando_cq'::text)) THEN 'aguardando_cq'::text
            WHEN (ed.cq_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'em_cq'::text
            WHEN (ed.lote_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'em_producao'::text
            WHEN (ed.programacao_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'programada'::text
            ELSE 'aberta'::text
        END AS status_esteira_oficial,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ed.data_inicio_producao - ed.created_at)) AS tempo_os_ate_programacao,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ed.data_lote - ed.data_inicio_producao)) AS tempo_programacao_ate_lote,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ed.data_cq - ed.data_lote)) AS tempo_lote_ate_cq,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ed.data_envase - ed.data_cq)) AS tempo_cq_ate_envase,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ed.data_entrega - ed.data_envase)) AS tempo_envase_ate_entrega,
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ed.data_entrega - ed.created_at)) AS tempo_os_ate_entrega,
    ((ed.data_programada IS NOT NULL) AND (ed.data_programada < CURRENT_DATE) AND (ed.status_os <> ALL (ARRAY['finalizada'::text, 'cancelada'::text]))) AS atrasado
   FROM (esteira_data ed
     LEFT JOIN entregas ent ON ((ent.id = ed.entrega_id)));

relations.name: _src_vw_fluxo_visita_tecnica
relations.view:
WITH cte_checkins AS (
         SELECT visitas_checkin.registro_consultor_id,
            min(visitas_checkin.data_hora_checkin) AS data_checkin,
            count(*) AS total_checkins
           FROM visitas_checkin
          GROUP BY visitas_checkin.registro_consultor_id
        ), cte_diagnosticos AS (
         SELECT visita_diagnosticos.registro_id AS registro_consultor_id,
            count(*) AS total_diagnosticos
           FROM visita_diagnosticos
          GROUP BY visita_diagnosticos.registro_id
        ), cte_evidencias AS (
         SELECT rca.registro_consultor_id,
            count(*) AS total_evidencias,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM registros_consultor_arquivos rca2
                  WHERE ((rca2.registro_consultor_id = rca.registro_consultor_id) AND (rca2.arquivo_path IS NULL)))) AS tem_arquivo_sem_path
           FROM registros_consultor_arquivos rca
          GROUP BY rca.registro_consultor_id
        ), cte_recomendacoes AS (
         SELECT rcr.registro_consultor_id,
            count(*) AS total_recomendacoes,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM registros_consultor_recomendacoes rcr2
                  WHERE ((rcr2.registro_consultor_id = rcr.registro_consultor_id) AND ((NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM rcr2.recomendacao_tecnica), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) OR (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM rcr2.observacoes_finais), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) OR (rcr2.estrategia_manejo IS NOT NULL))))) AS possui_conteudo_real
           FROM registros_consultor_recomendacoes rcr
          GROUP BY rcr.registro_consultor_id
        ), cte_os_stats AS (
         SELECT ordens_servico_onfarm.registro_consultor_id,
            count(*) AS total_os_vinculadas
           FROM ordens_servico_onfarm
          GROUP BY ordens_servico_onfarm.registro_consultor_id
        ), cte_os_single AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (ordens_servico_onfarm.registro_consultor_id) ordens_servico_onfarm.registro_consultor_id,
            ordens_servico_onfarm.id AS os_id,
            ordens_servico_onfarm.numero_os,
            (ordens_servico_onfarm.status)::text AS status_os,
            ordens_servico_onfarm.created_at AS data_geracao_os,
            ordens_servico_onfarm.microrganismo_id AS os_microrganismo_id
           FROM ordens_servico_onfarm
          ORDER BY ordens_servico_onfarm.registro_consultor_id, ordens_servico_onfarm.created_at DESC
        ), cte_logs_datas AS (
         SELECT visitas_logs.registro_consultor_id,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (visitas_logs.acao = 'visita_finalizada'::text) THEN visitas_logs.created_at
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END) AS data_log_finalizacao,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (visitas_logs.acao = 'recomendacao_liberada'::text) THEN visitas_logs.created_at
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END) AS data_log_liberacao,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (visitas_logs.acao = 'os_gerada'::text) THEN visitas_logs.created_at
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END) AS data_log_conversao
           FROM visitas_logs
          GROUP BY visitas_logs.registro_consultor_id
        ), cte_status_logs AS (
         SELECT registros_consultor_status_log.registro_consultor_id,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (registros_consultor_status_log.status_novo = 'aprovado'::text) THEN registros_consultor_status_log.changed_at
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END) AS data_status_aprovado,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (registros_consultor_status_log.status_novo = 'convertido_os'::text) THEN registros_consultor_status_log.changed_at
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
                END) AS data_status_convertido
           FROM registros_consultor_status_log
          GROUP BY registros_consultor_status_log.registro_consultor_id
        ), cte_aprovacoes AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (aprovacoes_tecnicas.registro_consultor_id) aprovacoes_tecnicas.registro_consultor_id,
            (aprovacoes_tecnicas.status_aprovacao)::text AS status_aprovacao,
            aprovacoes_tecnicas.data_aprovacao
           FROM aprovacoes_tecnicas
          ORDER BY aprovacoes_tecnicas.registro_consultor_id, aprovacoes_tecnicas.created_at DESC
        ), base_fluxo AS (
         SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN (rc_1.id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'visita_com_solicitacao'::text
                    ELSE 'solicitacao_sem_visita'::text
                END AS origem_fluxo,
            ps.id AS solicitacao_id,
            ps.numero_solicitacao,
            rc_1.id AS registro_consultor_id,
            rc_1.codigo_visita,
            ps.cliente_id,
            ps.fazenda_id,
            ps.talhao_id,
            rc_1.cultura_id,
            ps.consultor_atribuido AS consultor_id,
            ps.status AS status_solicitacao,
            (rc_1.status)::text AS status_visita,
            ps.tipo_demanda,
            ps.data_prevista_atendimento,
            ps.created_at AS solicitacao_created_at,
            rc_1.created_at AS visita_created_at,
            rc_1.updated_at AS visita_updated_at
           FROM (portal_solicitacoes ps
             LEFT JOIN registros_consultor rc_1 ON ((ps.id = rc_1.solicitacao_id)))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'visita_avulsa'::text AS origem_fluxo,
            NULL::uuid AS solicitacao_id,
            NULL::text AS numero_solicitacao,
            rc_1.id AS registro_consultor_id,
            rc_1.codigo_visita,
            rc_1.cliente_id,
            rc_1.fazenda_id,
            rc_1.talhao_id,
            rc_1.cultura_id,
            rc_1.consultor_responsavel AS consultor_id,
            NULL::text AS status_solicitacao,
            (rc_1.status)::text AS status_visita,
            NULL::text AS tipo_demanda,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS data_prevista_atendimento,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS solicitacao_created_at,
            rc_1.created_at AS visita_created_at,
            rc_1.updated_at AS visita_updated_at
           FROM registros_consultor rc_1
          WHERE (rc_1.solicitacao_id IS NULL)
        )
 SELECT bf.origem_fluxo,

            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END) AS data_finalizacao,
    COALESCE(cl.data_log_liberacao, sl.data_status_aprovado, ap.data_aprovacao) AS data_liberacao_recomendacao,
    COALESCE(os.data_geracao_os, cl.data_log_conversao, sl.data_status_convertido) AS data_conversao_os,
    (ck.data_checkin IS NOT NULL) AS possui_checkin,
    (COALESCE(dg.total_diagnosticos, (0)::bigint) > 0) AS possui_diagnostico,
    COALESCE(dg.total_diagnosticos, (0)::bigint) AS quantidade_diagnosticos,
    (COALESCE(ev.total_evidencias, (0)::bigint) > 0) AS possui_evidencias,
    COALESCE(ev.total_evidencias, (0)::bigint) AS quantidade_evidencias,
    COALESCE(rc.possui_conteudo_real, false) AS possui_recomendacao,
    COALESCE(rc.total_recomendacoes, (0)::bigint) AS quantidade_recomendacoes,
    (os.os_id IS NOT NULL) AS possui_os,
    os.os_id,
    os.numero_os,
    os.status_os,
    os.os_microrganismo_id AS microrganismo_id,
    mic.nome AS microrganismo_nome,
        CASE
            WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'convertido_os'::text) AND (os.os_id IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'Concluído'::text
            WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'convertido_os'::text) AND (os.os_id IS NULL)) THEN 'Corrigir vínculo da OS'::text
            WHEN ((bf.status_solicitacao = 'aguardando_decisao_produtor'::text) AND (bf.status_visita = 'aprovado'::text)) THEN 'Converter em OS'::text
            WHEN (bf.status_solicitacao = 'aguardando_decisao_produtor'::text) THEN 'Aguardando decisão do produtor'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(rc.possui_conteudo_real, false) AND (bf.status_visita = 'finalizado'::text)) THEN 'Liberar recomendação'::text
            WHEN ((COALESCE(dg.total_diagnosticos, (0)::bigint) > 0) AND (NOT COALESCE(rc.possui_conteudo_real, false))) THEN 'Emitir recomendação'::text
            WHEN ((ck.data_checkin IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(ev.total_evidencias, (0)::bigint) = 0)) THEN 'Inserir evidências'::text
            WHEN ((ck.data_checkin IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE(dg.total_diagnosticos, (0)::bigint) = 0)) THEN 'Registrar diagnóstico'::text
            WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'agendada'::text) OR (bf.status_solicitacao = 'agendada'::text)) THEN 'Realizar check-in'::text
            WHEN (bf.status_solicitacao = 'atribuida'::text) THEN 'Agendar visita'::text
            WHEN (bf.consultor_id IS NULL) THEN 'Atribuir consultor'::text
            ELSE 'Aguardando triagem'::text
        END AS proxima_acao,
    ARRAY( SELECT unnest(((((((((((
                CASE
                    WHEN (bf.consultor_id IS NULL) THEN ARRAY['sem_consultor'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ((bf.status_solicitacao = 'aberta'::text) AND (bf.consultor_id IS NOT NULL)) THEN ARRAY['sem_agendamento'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ((bf.registro_consultor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ck.data_checkin IS NULL)) THEN ARRAY['sem_checkin'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'finalizado'::text) AND (COALESCE(dg.total_diagnosticos, (0)::bigint) = 0)) THEN ARRAY['sem_diagnostico'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'finalizado'::text) AND (COALESCE(ev.total_evidencias, (0)::bigint) = 0)) THEN ARRAY['sem_evidencia'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'finalizado'::text) AND (NOT COALESCE(rc.possui_conteudo_real, false))) THEN ARRAY['sem_recomendacao'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'aprovado'::text) AND (NOT COALESCE(rc.possui_conteudo_real, false))) THEN ARRAY['aprovada_sem_recomendacao'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'aprovado'::text) AND (bf.status_solicitacao <> ALL (ARRAY['aguardando_decisao_produtor'::text, 'convertida_os'::text, 'concluida'::text]))) THEN ARRAY['aprovada_com_solicitacao_antiga'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ((bf.status_visita = 'convertido_os'::text) AND (os.os_id IS NULL)) THEN ARRAY['convertida_os_sem_os'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN (COALESCE(oss.total_os_vinculadas, (0)::bigint) > 1) THEN ARRAY['os_duplicada'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END) ||
                CASE
                    WHEN ev.tem_arquivo_sem_path THEN ARRAY['evidencia_sem_arquivo_path'::text]
                    ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
                END)) AS unnest) AS bloqueios,
    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - COALESCE(bf.solicitacao_created_at, bf.visita_created_at))) / 86400.0) AS dias_em_aberto,
    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ck.data_checkin - bf.solicitacao_created_at)) / 3600.0) AS tempo_solicitacao_ate_checkin,
    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(cl.data_log_finalizacao,
        CASE
            WHEN (bf.status_visita = 'finalizado'::text) THEN bf.visita_updated_at
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END) - ck.data_checkin)) / 3600.0) AS tempo_checkin_ate_finalizacao,
    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(cl.data_log_liberacao, sl.data_status_aprovado, ap.data_aprovacao) - COALESCE(cl.data_log_finalizacao,
        CASE
            WHEN (bf.status_visita = 'finalizado'::text) THEN bf.visita_updated_at
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END))) / 3600.0) AS tempo_finalizacao_ate_aprovacao,
    (EXTRACT(epoch FROM (COALESCE(os.data_geracao_os, cl.data_log_conversao, sl.data_status_convertido) - COALESCE(cl.data_log_liberacao, sl.data_status_aprovado, ap.data_aprovacao))) / 3600.0) AS tempo_aprovacao_ate_os,
    COALESCE(bf.solicitacao_created_at, bf.visita_created_at) AS created_at,
    COALESCE(bf.visita_updated_at, bf.solicitacao_created_at) AS updated_at
   FROM (((((((((((((((base_fluxo bf
     LEFT JOIN clientes c ON ((bf.cliente_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN fazendas f ON ((bf.fazenda_id = f.id)))
     LEFT JOIN talhoes t ON ((bf.talhao_id = t.id)))
     LEFT JOIN culturas cult ON ((bf.cultura_id = cult.id)))
     LEFT JOIN profiles u ON ((bf.consultor_id = u.id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_checkins ck ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = ck.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_diagnosticos dg ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = dg.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_evidencias ev ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = ev.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_recomendacoes rc ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = rc.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_os_single os ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = os.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_os_stats oss ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = oss.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_logs_datas cl ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = cl.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_status_logs sl ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = sl.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN cte_aprovacoes ap ON ((bf.registro_consultor_id = ap.registro_consultor_id)))
     LEFT JOIN microrganismos mic ON ((os.os_microrganismo_id = mic.id)));

relations.name: v_fiscal_sefaz_event_state
relations.view:
SELECT p.id AS event_id,
    p.fiscal_invoice_id,
    p.event_type,
    p.sefaz_event_code,
    p.sefaz_seq_evento,
    p.sefaz_access_key,
    p.sefaz_reason,
    p.idempotency_key,
    p.payload_fingerprint,
    p.performed_by,
    p.created_at,
    s.signed_xml_path,
    s.signed_xml_sha256,
    r.sefaz_c_stat,
    r.sefaz_n_prot,
        CASE
            WHEN (r.event_type = 'SEFAZ_EVENT_REGISTERED'::text) THEN 'REGISTERED'::text
            WHEN (r.event_type = 'SEFAZ_EVENT_REJECTED'::text) THEN 'REJECTED'::text
            WHEN (s.id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'SIGNED'::text
            ELSE 'PREPARED'::text
        END AS state
   FROM ((fiscal_events p
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.id,
            e.fiscal_invoice_id,
            e.event_type,
            e.status_before,
            e.status_after,
            e.event_source,
            e.provider_event_id,
            e.request_snapshot,
            e.response_snapshot,
            e.error_code,
            e.error_message,
            e.performed_by,
            e.created_at,
            e.notes,
            e.idempotency_key,
            e.payload_fingerprint,
            e.related_event_id,
            e.sefaz_event_code,
            e.sefaz_seq_evento,
            e.sefaz_access_key,
            e.sefaz_reason,
            e.signed_xml_path,
            e.signed_xml_sha256,
            e.sefaz_c_stat,
            e.sefaz_n_prot,
            e.sefaz_transmission_id
           FROM fiscal_events e
          WHERE ((e.related_event_id = p.id) AND (e.event_type = 'SEFAZ_EVENT_SIGNED'::text))
          ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) s ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.id,
            e.fiscal_invoice_id,
            e.event_type,
            e.status_before,
            e.status_after,
            e.event_source,
            e.provider_event_id,
            e.request_snapshot,
            e.response_snapshot,
            e.error_code,
            e.error_message,
            e.performed_by,
            e.created_at,
            e.notes,
            e.idempotency_key,
            e.payload_fingerprint,
            e.related_event_id,
            e.sefaz_event_code,
            e.sefaz_seq_evento,
            e.sefaz_access_key,
            e.sefaz_reason,
            e.signed_xml_path,
            e.signed_xml_sha256,
            e.sefaz_c_stat,
            e.sefaz_n_prot,
            e.sefaz_transmission_id
           FROM fiscal_events e
          WHERE ((e.related_event_id = p.id) AND (e.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['SEFAZ_EVENT_REGISTERED'::text, 'SEFAZ_EVENT_REJECTED'::text])))
          ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) r ON (true))
  WHERE (p.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['SEFAZ_CANCELLATION_PREPARED'::text, 'SEFAZ_CORRECTION_PREPARED'::text]));

relations.view:

    ((g.gate ->> 'quarantined'::text))::boolean AS quarantined,
    (reg.facts -> 'dossier_id'::text) AS dossier_id,
    (reg.facts ->> 'status'::text) AS dossier_status,
    (g.gate -> 'pendencies'::text) AS pendencies,
    (g.gate -> 'not_applicable'::text) AS not_applicable,
    g.gate
   FROM (((microrganismos m
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT mfp.id,
            mfp.microorganism_id,
            mfp.is_active,
            mfp.fiscal_description,
            mfp.commercial_unit,
            mfp.taxable_unit,
            mfp.ncm,
            mfp.cest,
            mfp.origin_code,
            mfp.cfop_in_state,
            mfp.cfop_interstate,
            mfp.icms_cst,
            mfp.icms_csosn,
            mfp.pis_cst,
            mfp.cofins_cst,
            mfp.ipi_cst,
            mfp.gtin,
            mfp.taxable_gtin,
            mfp.tax_benefit_code,
            mfp.profile_status,
            mfp.accounting_notes,
            mfp.accounting_validated_at,
            mfp.accounting_validated_by,
            mfp.created_at,
            mfp.updated_at,
            mfp.created_by,
            mfp.updated_by
           FROM microorganism_fiscal_profiles mfp
          WHERE (mfp.microorganism_id = m.id)
          ORDER BY (mfp.is_active AND (mfp.profile_status = 'VALIDATED'::text)) DESC, mfp.is_active DESC, mfp.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, mfp.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, mfp.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) sel ON (true))
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts(m.id) AS facts) reg)
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT fn_fiscal_item_profile_gate_eval('MICROORGANISM'::text, fn_fiscal_company_crt(), sel.is_active, sel.profile_status, sel.accounting_validated_at, sel.accounting_notes, sel.fiscal_description, sel.commercial_unit, sel.taxable_unit, sel.ncm, sel.origin_code, sel.cfop_in_state, sel.cfop_interstate, sel.icms_cst, sel.icms_csosn, sel.pis_cst, sel.cofins_cst, reg.facts) AS gate) g);
